text: Piiter Leenzi, gurbaa ganna 13 mootor saayikilii gulufu,daandii si’ataa mootora irra gulufan Saffisaa Mootoraa Indiyaanaapoois irratti balaa isarra ga’een lubbunsaa darbe.
eng_text: Peter Lenz, a 13-year-old motorcycle racer, has died after being involved in a crash at the Indianapolis Motor Speedway.

text: Shaakala jalqabaa isaa irratti, Leenziin biskileettii isaa irraa kufe, itti ansees morkataa isaa Zhaaviyeer Zaayaatiin rukutame.
eng_text: While on his warm-up lap, Lenz fell off his bike, and was then struck by fellow racer Xavier Zayat.

text: Hojjettoota fayyaa toora irra jiraniin atattamaan ilaalamee gara hospitaala naannoo sanaa, bakka inni itti du’eetti geeffame.
eng_text: He was immediately attended to by the on-track medical staff and transported to a local hospital where he later died.

text: Zayaat balaa sana keessatti hin miidhamne.
eng_text: Zayat was unhurt in the accident.

text: Gama haala faayinaansii addunyaan, Zaapaateeroon "sirni faayinaansii qaama dinagdeeti, qaama baayyee barbaachisaa, " jechuun itti fufe.
eng_text: Regarding the global financial situation, Zapatero continued by saying that "the financial system is a part of the economy, a crucial part.

text: Rakkoo dinagdee waggaa tokkoof ture qabna, kunis ji’oota lamaan darban keessa guddaa ture, amma akka ani yaadutti dinagdeen fooyya’iinsa jalqabaa jira.
eng_text: We have a year-long financial crisis, which has had its most acute moment in the past two months, and I think now the financial markets are beginning to recover."

text: Torban darbe, Oduun Qullaan ibsa baaseen bifa ajaayibaan dirqama gabaasa oduusaa kan afaan addunyaa, tamsaasa haaraa sadii’n akka dabaluudha.
eng_text: Last week, Naked News announced that it would dramatically increase its international language mandate to news reporting, with three new broadcasts.

text: Afaan Ingiliziitiifi Afaan Jaappaaniitiin kan duraanuu gabaasaa jiru dhaabbati addunyaa kun teeleviizhiinii, marsariitii fi bilbila sochootuudhaaf Afaan Ispeenii, Xaaliyaanii, akkasumas Afaan Kooriyaatiin sagantaalee eegalee jira.
eng_text: Already reporting in English and Japanese, the global organization is launching Spanish, Italian, and Korean-language programs, for television, the web, and mobile devices.

text: "Akka carraa ta’ee homtuu narratti hin raawwanne, yeroo namoonni ba’uudhaaf jedhanii foddaawwan caccabsan garuu taatee suukkanneessaan arge.
eng_text: "Luckily nothing happened to me, but I saw a macabre scene, as people tried to break windows in order to get out.

text: Namootni fuullee foddichaa barcumaan rukutaa turani, garuu foddaawwan sunniin kan caban hin turre.
eng_text: People were hitting the panes with chairs, but the windows were unbreakable.

text: Fulleen foddaa tokko dhuma irratti cabnaan, karaa foddaa ba’uu eegalan,” jedhe kan lubbuun ba’e Firansiiszeek Koowal.
eng_text: One of the panes finally broke, and they started to get out by the window," said survivor Franciszek Kowal.

text: Urjileen ifaa if hoo’a kan keennan sababa huumna atoomiin haaydirojiinii elementoota ulfaatoo uumuuf walitti makamaniifi (yookiin fiyuzii ta’aanii walitti qabamaniifi).
eng_text: Stars give off light and heat because of the energy made when hydrogen atoms are merged (or fused) together to form heavier elements.

text: Saayinstistootni akkataa itti wal-nyaachisaan humna karaa wal fakkataan itti uumuu danda’u irratti hojjechaa jiru.
eng_text: Scientists are working to create a reactor that can make energy in the same way.

text: Kun garuu, furuuf rakkoo baay’ee rakkisaa ta’e fi kan walnyaatinsa walitti dhufuu bu’a-qabeessa osoo hin argiin waggoota baay’ee fudhachuu danda’udha.
eng_text: This, however, is a very hard problem to solve and will take many years before we see useful fusion reactors built.

text: Lilmoon sibilaa ulfaatina salphaa waan qabuuf bishaan gubbaa bololi’a.
eng_text: The steel needle floats on top of the water because of surface tension.

text: Walharkisi irrakeessa bishaanii kan inni uumamuuf moleekiyuulonni bishaanii irrakeessatti argaman moleekiyuulota qilleensaa isaan gararraatti argaman caalaa humna cimaadhaan gara walii walii isaaniitti waan harkifamaniifidha.
eng_text: Surface tension happens because the water molecules at the surface of the water are strongly attracted to each other more than they are to the air molecules above them.

text: Moolekiyuloonni bishaanii qaama bishaanii irratti baqqaana hin mul’anne umanii wantoonni akka lilmoo fakkaatan gubbaa bishaaniitti akka bololi’an godhu.
eng_text: The water molecules make an invisible skin on the water’s surface that allows things like the needle to float on top of the water.

text: Haadduun iskeetii cabbii kan hammayyaa irra jiru fiixa dachaa dhooqa koonkeevii isaan jidduu kan qabu dha. Dhooqni lameen kunniin cabbiin akka gaaritti qabu, yerooma olii gadi ta’u illee.
eng_text: The blade on a modern ice skate has a double edge with a concave hollow between them. The two edges allow for a better grasp of the ice, even when tilted.

text: Sababa jalli qarabaa xiqqoo dabuuf, yeroo qarabichi gara kanatti yookaan gara biraaatti dabu fixeen cabbie wajjin wal-tuqee jirus ni daba.
eng_text: Because the bottom of the blade is slightly curved, as the blade tilts to one side or the other, the edge which is in contact with the ice also curves.

text: Kuni iskeeterin akka marfatu godha. Yoo iskeetiin gara mirgaatti jallate, gara mirgaatti goora, yoo iskeetiin gara bitaatti gore, gara bittaatti gora.
eng_text: This causes the skater to turn. If the skates tilt to the right, the skater turns right, if the skates tilt to the left, the skater turns left.

text: Gara sadarka humna isaa isa duritti deebi’uuf, humna dabalata ifaa irra argatan irra aanu qabu.
eng_text: To return to their previous energy level, they must get rid of the extra energy they got from the light.

text: Kana kan isaan godhan qaanqee ifaa xiqqoo, kan “footoon” jedhamtu facaasuudhaani.
eng_text: They do this by emitting a tiny particle of light called a "photon".

text: Saayinsistoonni adeemsa kana “ yaa’umsa raadiyeeshinii qindaa’e ” jedhanii waamu, atoomonni sababa ifa guddaan ka’aniif, yaa’umsa footoonii ifaaf sababa ta’uu akkasumas ifni akaakuu raadiyeeshiniidha.
eng_text: Scientists call this process "stimulated emission of radiation" because the atoms are stimulated by the bright light, causing the emission of a photon of light, and light is a type of radiation.

text: Suuraan itti aanu atomoonni yeroo footoonii gad lakkissan mullisa. Maal ree, haqaan footoniin kanneen suuraa irratti mul’atan caalaa baay’ee xixiqqoodha.
eng_text: The next picture shows the atoms emitting photons. Of course, in reality photons are a lot smaller than those in the picture.

text: Footoononni warren walitti dhufuun atoomiiumman irraayyuu baayye xiqqaadha.
eng_text: Photons are even smaller than the stuff that makes up atoms!

text: Ergaa sa’aati dhibban lakka’amuuf hojjateen booda shiiboon keessa balbii jiru dhumarratti ni gubata kanaaf kana booda ibsaan hin hojjatu.
eng_text: After hundreds of hours of operation the filament in the bulb eventually burns out and the light bulb no longer works.

text: Baalbiin ifaa bakka buusuu barbaada. Yeroo baalbiin ifaa bakka buufamu of eeggannoon gudhamuu qaba.
eng_text: The light bulb then needs replacing. It is necessary to be careful in replacing the light bulb.

text: Jalqaba, iswiichiin ibsaa kanaa dhaamu qaba yookiin ammo funyoo eleektriikii gargar baasuudha.
eng_text: First, the switch for the light fixture needs to be turned off or the cable disconnected.

text: Kunis sababni isaa gaafa Elektirikiin gara sookeetiiti deemu balbiin gari Sibiila isaa ibsaan akka si keessa darbu gochuu danda’u yoo keessoo sookeetii tuqxe yookiin qaama balbicha keessa isaa sibiila osoodhumaa inni sokeetii keessa jiru.
eng_text: This is because electricity flowing into the socket where the metallic part of bulb sits can give you a severe electric shock if you touch the inside of the socket or the metal base of the bulb while it is still partly in the socket.

text: Qaamni sirna marsaa dhiigaa inni guddaan onneedha, isa dhiiga raabsuudha.
eng_text: The major organ of the circulatory system is the heart, which pumps the blood.

text: Dhiigi ujummoowwan aarterii jedhamuun beekamaniin onnee keessaa kan ba’uu fi ujummoowwan veeyinii jedhamaniin gara onneetti kan deebi’udha. Ujummoowwan hundarra xixiqqoon kaappilaaroota jedhamu.
eng_text: Blood goes away from the heart in tubes called arteries and comes back to the heart in tubes called veins. The smallest tubes are called capillaries.

text: Ilkaan “triseratopiis” kan caccabsuu danda’u ture baala qofa utuu hin ta’in damee bayyee cimaa fi hundee illee dabalateeti.
eng_text: A triceratops' teeth would have been able to crush not only leaves but even very tough branches and roots.

text: Saayintistootni muraasni akka yaadaniiti Triceratoponni akka cycadsin nyaataniti dha, kanneen biqiloota beekamoo ta’an Cretaceous keessatti.
eng_text: Some scientists think Triceratops ate cycads, which are a type of plant that was common in the Cretaceous.

text: Biqiltuuwwan kunniin muka teemirii isa baalli qaqqaramaan isaa walitti guujja’ee mataarra taa’u fakkaatu.
eng_text: These plants look like a small palm tree with a crown of sharp, spiky leaves.

text: Triceratoponni bikii isaa isa cimaa fayyadamuu ni danda’a ture baala irraa fudhuun osoo tirankii isaa hin nyaatin.
eng_text: A Triceratops could have used its strong beak to strip off the leaves before eating the trunk.

text: Saayintistootni adda biraan kan irratti wal falmaan akka biqilootni kun summaawwa ta’aanidha, kanaaf daayinosarootni isaan nyaachun waan hin fakkannee dha, yoodhumaa har’a iyyuu slotii fi bineensotni adda bira kanneen akka urunguu (kan Daayinosarri irraa dhufe) baalota yookiin fudurawwan summaawwa nyaachuu danda’aniyyuu.
eng_text: Other scientists argue that these plants are very poisonous so it is unlikely that any dinosaur ate them, even though today the sloth and other animals like the parrot (a descendant of the dinosaurs) can eat poisonous leaves or fruit.

text: Harkisi lo akkamittiin na harkisa? Yoo irra keessa lo irra dhaabatte, hanga Lafa irratti ulfaattuu gadi ulfaatta.
eng_text: How would Io's gravity pull on me? If you stood on the surface of Io, you would weigh less than you do on Earth.

text: Namni lafa irratti paawondii 200 (kiiloo giraama 90) ulfaatu lo irratti paawundii 36 (kiiloo giraamii 16) ulfaata. Kanaaf, dhuguma iyyuu, harkisni lafaa xiqqoodhuma si harkisa.
eng_text: A person who weighs 200 pounds (90kg) on Earth would weigh about 36 pounds (16kg) on Io. So the gravity, of course, pulls less on you.

text: Aduun akka Lafaa uwwisa irra keessaa kan irra dhaabatan hinqabdu. Aduun guutummaan ishee gaasii, ibiddaafi pilaazmaa irraa tolfamte.
eng_text: The Sun doesn't have a crust like the Earth that you can stand on. The whole Sun is made out of gases, fire, and plasma.

text: Gaaziin akkuma giddugala aduu irraa fagaataa deemtaniin qal’ataa deema.
eng_text: The gas becomes thinner as you go farther from the center of the Sun.

text: Qaamni bakkee kan gaafa Aduu ilaalu nuti arginu footosfeer jedhamu, “kubbaa ifaa” jechuu dha.
eng_text: The outer-part we see when we look at the Sun is called the photosphere, which means "ball of light".

text: Waggoota kumaa sadii boode, 1610 keessa, Astiroonomariin Xaaliyanii Galiliyoo Galilee Teleeskopii fayyadamuun Veenuusiin ilaale akka ishee kutaawwan qabdu beekuuf, akkuma Jinni qabdu.
eng_text: About three thousand years later, in 1610, Italian astronomer Galileo Galilei used a telescope to observe that Venus has phases, just as the moon does.

text: Marsaaleen kan uumaman sababa gartokkeen Veenus (ykn kan Addeessaa) inni gara aduutti gara galee jiru qofatti ifti itti baheefidha. Marsaawwan addeessaa kun tiyooriii Koopparniikas isa pilaaneetonni aduutti marsu jedhu deeggara.
eng_text: Phases happen because only the side of Venus (or of the Moon) facing the Sun is lighted. The phases of Venus supported the theory of Copernicus that the planets go around the Sun.

text: Sana booda, waggoota muraasa booda bara 1639 tti, Astiironomeerin Ingiiland maqaan isaa Jerimiyaa Hoorooksii jedhamu darbuu Veenas argeera.
eng_text: Then, a few years later in 1639, an English astronomer named Jeremiah Horrocks observed a transit of Venus.

text: Ingilaandi erga weerara irra deebii Daaneelaw booda nagaa yeroo dheeraa argattee turte.
eng_text: England had experienced a long period of peace after the reconquest of the Danelaw.

text: Haa ta’uu iyyuu malee 991’ti Ethelereditti dooniiwwan Vaayikiingii kanneen erga kan Guutrum isaan jarraa tokko duraa caalaa guddatantu itti dhufe.
eng_text: However in 991 Ethelred was faced with a Viking fleet larger than any since Guthrum's a century earlier.

text: Atiluun kun Olaaf Tiraayigivassooniin hogganame, nama Norweeyii kan biyya isaa to’annaa warra Deenmaark jalaa deebisee baasuuf abjuu qabuudha.
eng_text: This fleet was led by Olaf Trygvasson, a Norwegian with ambitions to reclaim his country from Danish domination.

text: Erga duubatti deebi’iinsa humna waraanaa duraanii booda, Itelred waliigaltee Oolaaf isa Noorwayitti deebi’ee aangoo mootummaa bulchiinsa isaa aangoo waliiniin qabachuuf yaalaa jiru wajjin waliigaluu danda’eera.
eng_text: After initial military setbacks, Ethelred was able to agree to terms with Olaf, who returned to Norway to try to gain his kingdom with mixed success.

text: Hangewul sirna qubee itti yaadamee hojjetamee faayidaa guyyaaf baayyee biratti beekame isa tokkichadha. Sirni qubee sun 1444 keessa yeroo bulchiinsa Mootii Sejoong (1418-1450)’tti kalaqame.
eng_text: Hangeul is the only purposely invented alphabet in popular daily use. The alphabet was invented in 1444 during the reign of King Sejong (1418 – 1450).

text: Mootin Seejoongii mootii afuraffaa Mootummaa Joosiyoon kan turee fi warreen baayye beekaman keessaas tokko ture.
eng_text: King Sejong was the fourth king of the Joseon Dynasty and is one of the most highly regarded.

text: Jalqabumati haala qubee Hanguwel kan inni itti moggaase Hunmin Jeongeum jedheti, kana jechuunis “sagaleewwan sirrii namaaf qajeelfamaa kennuuf”.
eng_text: He originally named the Hangeul alphabet Hunmin Jeongeum, which means "the correct sounds for the instruction of the people".

text: Akkaataa Saaniskiriit dhufe irratti yaad-rimeewwan hedduutu jiru. Isaan keessaa tokko godaansa warri Aariyaan, kanneen afaan isaanii achi geessan, dhiha irraa gara Indiyaatti godhanidha.
eng_text: There are many theories to how Sanskrit came into existence. One of them is about an Aryan migration from the west into India who brought their language with them.

text: Saanskiriit afaan durduriiti, afaan Laatiinii isaAwurooppaa keessatti dubbatamuun kan walfakkeeffamuu danda’udha.
eng_text: Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe.

text: Addunyaa irrattii Kitaabni beekamaan inni jalqabaa Saaniskiritiiin barreeffame. Erga xumura Upanishaadotaa booda, sababa gulantaan saaniskiritiin gadhiise.
eng_text: The earliest known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the compilation of Upanishads, Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy.

text: Saaniskiriitiin afaan baay’ee walxaxaa fi badhaadhaadha, kan afaanota Hindii ammayyaa baay’eef akka maddaatti tajaajile, akkuma Laatiin madda afaanota Awurooppaa kan akka Fireenchii fi Ispaanishii ta’e.
eng_text: Sanskrit is a very complex and rich language, which has served to be the source for many modern Indian languages, just like Latin is the source for European languages like French and Spanish.

text: Erga lolli Faransaayii waliinii xumuramee, Jarmaniin odola Biriiteen weeraruuf qophaa’uu eegalte.
eng_text: With the battle for France over, Germany began to get ready to invade the island of Britain.

text: Jarmaniin haleellaa sana maqaa koodii “Haleellaa Siilaayen” jedhu itti moggaafte. Meeshaaleen waraanaa guguddoonii fi dhiyeessiin Waraana Ingilizii harki caalaan isaa yeroo isaan Dankirkiin gad-dhiisan badee ture, kanaaf waraanni sun hanga tokko dadhabaa ture.
eng_text: Germany code-named the attack “Operation Sealion”. Most of the British Army's heavy weapons and supplies had been lost when it evacuated from Dunkirk, so the army was fairly weak.

text: Garuu ammas Naaviin Rooyaal Naavii Jarman (“Kiriigismaariin") caala cimaadha akkasumas doonii weerara karaa Engiliiziin ergaman hunda barbadeessuu danda’ee jira.
eng_text: But the Royal Navy was still much stronger than the German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) and could have destroyed any invasion fleet sent across the English Channel.

text: Haa ta’u malee, ajajootni olaanoon waraana galaanaa rukuttaa humna qilleensaa Jermaniin liqimfamuu malu jedhanii waan sodaataniif, bidiruuwwan Waraanaa warra Mootii xurreewwan weeraraaf malan bukkeen kaa’aman.
eng_text: However, very few Royal Navy ships were based near the likely invasion routes as the admirals were afraid they would be sunk by German air attack.

text: Mee waa’ee karoora Xaaliyaanii ibsuudhaan haa eegallu. Xaaliyaaniin keessumaa “obboleessa xiqqaa” Jarmanii fi Jaappaanii turte.
eng_text: Let's start with an explanation about Italy's plans. Italy was mainly the "little brother" of Germany and Japan.

text: Jalqabbii waraanaatiin dura doonii haaraa afur haa ijaaran malee Humna waraanaa fi humna galaanaa dadhabaa qaban.
eng_text: It had a weaker army and a weaker navy, although they had just built four new ships right before the beginning of the war.

text: Galmawwan guguddoon Xaaliyaanii biyyoota Afriikaa ture. Biyyoota sanniin qabachuuf, waraanni Galaana Meediitiraaniyaanii ce’ee Afriikaa weeraruuf bakka loltuuwwan irraa bobbaafaman qabaachuutu isii barbaachisa ture.
eng_text: Italy's main goals were African countries. To capture those countries, they would need to have a troop launching pad, so as troops could sail across the Mediterranean Sea and invade Africa.

text: Sanaaf, buufataalee fi dooniiwwan Biriitish biyya Masir irraa fagaachuu qabu. Gochawwan sanniinitti dabaluudhaan, dooniiwwan waraanaa Xaaliyaanii wanta biraa kam iyyuu gochuu hinqaban turan.
eng_text: For that, they had to get rid of British bases and ships in Egypt. Besides those actions, Italy's battleships were not supposed to do anything else.

text: Amma Jaappaaniif. Jaapaan biyya oddolaadha, akkuma Biriitaniiyaa.
eng_text: Now for Japan. Japan was an island country, just like Britain.

text: Sabmariinonni dooniiwwan bishaan jala akka deemaniifi yeroo dheeraadhaaf achuma jala turuu danda’anitti hojjetamanidha.
eng_text: Submarines are ships designed to travel underwater, and remain there for an extended amount of time.

text: Sabmariinonni Waraana Addunyaa 1ffaa fi 2ffaa keessatti hojiirra oolanii turan. Yeroo sanitti baay’ee suuta kan jedhaniifi fageenyi isaan itti dhukaasanis murtaawaa ture.
eng_text: Submarines were used in World War I and World War II. Back then they were very slow and had a very limited shooting range.

text: Jalqaba lolaa irratti yeroo baayyee galaana irra deemaa turan, garuu akkuma raadaariin uumamaa fi bayyee sirrataa dhufeen dooniin galaana jala deemtu guttumman akka hin muldhanneef gaalaana jala deemuuf dirqaman.
eng_text: In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen.

text: Dooniin bishaan keessaa Jarmani Doonii-U jedhama. Jarmanoonni doonii bishaan isaanii imalchiisuu fi hojjachiisuu irratti baay’ee gaariidha.
eng_text: German submarines were called U-Boats. The Germans were very good at navigating and operating their submarines.

text: Sababaa milkaa’ina isaanii kanneen bishaan jala wajjin, Jeermanootni hin amanamne hedduu isaanii qabachuf.
eng_text: Because of their success with submarines, after the war Germans aren't trusted to have many of them.

text: Eeyyee! Mootichi Tutankhamun, inni aal tokko tokko “Mooticha Tut” yookaan “Mootii Isa Mucaa Dhiiraa” jedhamuun beekamu, bara ammayyaa keessatti mootota biyya Masir durii hunda caalaa bebbeekamoo keessaa isa tokkodha.
eng_text: Yes! King Tutankhamun, sometimes referred to as "King Tut" or "The Boy King", is one of the most well known ancient Egyptian kings in modern times.

text: Wanti baay’ee bara duriitti inni akka nama i baayee barbaachisaatti hin fudhatamne, akkasumas galmeewwan moototaa durii irratti hin galmoofne.
eng_text: Interestingly, he was not considered to be very important in ancient times and was not recorded on most ancient king lists.

text: Haa ta’uuyyu malee, argamni bakka awwaalchaa kana bara 1922 tti akka beekamuu isa taasisee. Yooma awwalchii baayeen barootaa darbanii haatamaniyyu, awwalchootni baayeen isaani eegannon hin taasifamneef.
eng_text: However, the discovery of his tomb in 1922 made him a celebrity. While many tombs of the past were robbed, this tomb was left virtually undisturbed.

text: Meeshaalee sibiila gati-jabeessaa fi dhagaa hin argamne irra hojjetaman kumaatama dabalatee meeshaaleen Tutankhamun waliin awwaalaman hedduun sirritti kunuunfamaniiru.
eng_text: Most of the items buried with Tutankhamun have been well preserved, including thousands of artefacts made from precious metals and rare stones.

text: Kalaqqiin masakaa dubbattuu Asiriyaan chaariyooti salphaa, saffisaafi haala gaaritti akka loltootaafi Chariyoota kan biraa caalaa figsiisan godhee jira.
eng_text: The invention of spoke wheels made Assyrian chariots lighter, faster, and better prepared to outrun soldiers and other chariots.

text: Xiyyoonni darbattuuwwan xiyyaa ajjeesoo isaaniirraa ba’an golgaa sibiilaa loltoota morkattootaa cabsanii seenuu kan danda’an turan. Naannoo 1000 Dh.K.D., Asiriyanootni lola fardaanii isaa jalqabaa eegalani.
eng_text: Arrows from their deadly crossbows could penetrate the armor of rival soldiers. About 1000 B.C., the Assyrians introduced the first cavalry.

text: Kavalaryiiin loltu dugda fardaa irra taa’ee loluu dha. Kooraan dugda fardaarra ka’amu hin kalaqamne ture, kanaaf loltootni Kavalaryii Assiriyaa qullaa dugda ardoota irra ta’ani lolan.
eng_text: A cavalry is an army that fights on horseback. The saddle had not yet been invented, so the Assyrian cavalry fought on the bare backs of their horses.

text: Namoota siyaasaa, saayintiistootaa, fi artistoota Giriikii baay’ee beekna. Namni hunda caalaa beekaman aadaa kanaa Hoomeridha, barreessa goota qaroo dhabeessa, ogbarruuwwan Giriikii bebbeekamoo lama kan qopheesse: walaloowwan IIliyaadii fi Oodiiseey.
eng_text: We know many Greek politicians, scientists, and artists. Possibly the most known person of this culture is Homer, the legendary blind poet, who composed two masterpieces of Greek literature: the poems Iliad and Odyssey.

text: Soofookilsii fi Aristoofaanes amallee bareessitoota taphaa beekamoo dha, taphonnii isaanii ogbarruu addunyaa keessaa akka hojiiwwan hunda caalaa guguddootti ilaalamu.
eng_text: Sophocles and Aristophanes are still popular playwrights and their plays are considered to be among the greatest works of world literature.

text: Hayyuu beekamaan Giriikii biraan, ogeessa herregaa Paayitaagorasidha, isa seerota aljeebiraa isaa waa’ee hariiroowwan rogawwan rogsadee roga qajeelaatiin beekamu.
eng_text: Another famous Greek is a mathematician Pythagoras, mostly known for his famous theorem about relations of the sides of right triangles.

text: Namoonni meeqa afaan Hindii akka dubbatan ilaalchisee tilmaama adda addaatu jira. Afaanota addunyaa irratti dubbataman guguddoo keessaa kanneen sadarkaa lammaaffa fi afuraffaa gidduu jiran gidduutti argama jedhamee tilmaamama.
eng_text: There are varying estimates for how many people speak Hindi. It is estimated to be between the second and fourth most commonly spoken language in the world.

eng_text: The number of native speakers varies depending on whether or not very closely related dialects are counted.

eng_text: Estimates range from 340 million to 500 million speakers, and as many as 800 million people can understand the language.

text: Afaan Hindii fi Urduun galmee jechootan walfakkaatoodha garuu barreeffamaan adda adda; haasaa guyyaa guyyaa keessatti, kan afaan lamaansaa dubbatan walii isaanii nii hubatu.
eng_text: Hindi and Urdu are similar in vocabulary but different in script; in everyday conversations, speakers of both languages can usually understand each other.

eng_text: Around the 15th century, northern Estonia was under great cultural influence of Germany.

eng_text: It was based on the German alphabet and one character "Õ/õ" was added.

eng_text: As time passed, many words that were borrowed from German coalesced. This was the beginning of enlightenment.

eng_text: However, Charles went to university at Trinity College, Cambridge where he studied Anthropology and Archaeology, and later History, earning a 2:2 (a lower second class degree).

eng_text: Charles was the first member of the British Royal Family to be awarded a degree.

eng_text: The territory of Turkey is more than 1,600 kilometres (1,000 mi) long and 800 km (500 mi) wide, with a roughly rectangular shape.

eng_text: Turkey's area, including lakes, occupies 783,562 square kilometres (300,948 sq mi), of which 755,688 square kilometres (291,773 sq mi) are in south west Asia and 23,764 square kilometres (9,174 sq mi) in Europe.

text: Bal’inni Turkii akka isheen addunyaa irraa sadarkaa 37 irra teessu taasisaa, akkasumas bal’inni ishee Faransaayii fi Yuunayiitid Kingidaam bakka tokkotti hamma ta’aan ga’a.
eng_text: Turkey's area makes it the world's 37th-largest country, and is about the size of Metropolitan France and the United Kingdom combined.

eng_text: Turkey is encircled by seas on three sides: the Aegean Sea to the west, the Black Sea to the north and the Mediterranean Sea to the south.

text: Luxembourg seenaa dheeraa qaba ,garuu kan inni of-danda’e bara 1839 irraa ka’eetu.
eng_text: Luxembourg has a long history but its independence dates from 1839.

text: Baroota darbaanitti kutaa Beeljem ammaa kutaa Luuzeenbergi turan garuu bara 1830tti warraqsaa warraa Beeljemiin booda,kan Beeljem taasifame.
eng_text: Present-day parts of Belgium were part of Luxembourg in the past but became Belgian after the 1830s Belgian Revolution.

text: Legzamburgi yeroo hundaa bilisa taatee hafuuf yaalteetti garuu Waraana Addunyaa Tokkoffaa fi Waraana Addunyaa Lammaffaa lamaanuu keessatti Jarmaniin qabamteetti.
eng_text: Luxembourg has always tried to remain a neutral country but it was occupied in both World War I and World War II by Germany.

text: Bara 1957 keessa Lukzembergi miseensota dhaabbaticha hundeessan keessaa tokko taate, kan har’a Gamtaa Awurooppaa jedhamuun beekamu.
eng_text: In 1957 Luxembourg became a founding member of the organization which is today known as the European Union.

eng_text: The Drukgyal Dzong is a ruined fortress and Buddhist monastery in the upper part of the Paro District (in Phondey Village).

eng_text: It is said that in 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel created the fortress to commemorate his victory against the Tibetan-Mongol forces.

eng_text: In 1951, a fire caused for only some of the relics of the Drukgyal Dzong to remain, such as the image of Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.

text: Balaa ibiddaa sana booda, masaraan dahannaa sun bakkatti deebifamee akkasumas eegameera, hawwata Bihutaanii namatti tolan keessa isa tokko ta’ee hafuudhaan.
eng_text: After the fire, the fortress was preserved and protected, remaining to be one of Bhutan's most sensational attractions.

text: Jaarraa 18ffaa keessa Kaamboodiyaan biyyoota oollaa humna qaban lama, Taayilaandi fi Veetnaam.
eng_text: During the 18th century Cambodia found itself squeezed between two powerful neighbors, Thailand and Vietnam.

text: Warreen Tiyaa jaarraa 18ffaa keessa yeroo baayee Kombodiyaa kan qabatanii fi 1772 keessa immoo Piihnoom Piheeniin balleessan.
eng_text: The Thais invaded Cambodia several times in the 18th century and in 1772 they destroyed Phnom Phen.

text: Dhuma waggoota jaarraa 18ffaa keessatti Veetinihaamis Kaamboodiyaa weerarteetti.
eng_text: In the last years of the 18th century the Vietnamese also invaded Cambodia.

text: Lammiileen Veenzuweelaa parsantii kudha saddeet hojii dhabeeyyiidha, akkasumas kanneen mindeeffamanis diinagdee dhaabbataa hin taane keessa kan hojjataniidha.
eng_text: Eighteen percent of Venezuelans are unemployed, and most of those who are employed work in the informal economy.

text: Veenzuweelonni harki lama sadaffaaan kan sektara tajaajilaa keessa hojjetan, nuusa kan ta’an indastrii keessa akkasumas shanaffaan qonna irra hojjetu.
eng_text: Two thirds of Venezuelans who work do so in the service sector, nearly a quarter work in industry and a fifth work in agriculture.

text: Warra Benezuweellaatiif induustirii cimaan boba’aadha, yooma induustiricha keessaa namoonni hojjetan dhibbeentaan tokko ta’anillee, kan biyyattiin ofumaaf alatti ergitudha.
eng_text: An important industry for Venezuelans is oil, where the country is a net exporter, even though only one percent work in the oil industry.

text: Jalqaba bilisummaa biyyaa keessatti, muuxannoon Mooraa Biqiltootaa Singaapoor lafa bishaan gidduutti argamtu gara Magaalaa Biqiltuu tirooppikaalaatti jijjiiruuf fayyada.
eng_text: Early in the nation's independence, Singapore Botanic Gardens' expertise helped to transform the island into a tropical Garden City.

text: Bara 1981ALA, Vaandaa Miis Johaakiim kan jedhamu, kan makaa abaaboo Orkiid ta’e, akka abaaboo biyyaalessa biyyattiitti filame.
eng_text: In 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, an orchid hybrid, was chosen as the nation's national flower.

text: Bara baraan naannoo ji’a Onkoloolessaa, bineensotni margaa fi biqiltuu sooratan kan miliyoona 1.5tti dhiyaatan rooba barbaacha laga Maaraa qaxxaamuruun gaarota kaabaarraa gara dirree kibbaatti geejjiba taasisu.
eng_text: Every year around October nearly 1.5 million herbivores travel towards the southern plains, crossing the Mara River, from the northern hills for the rains.

text: Sana booda immoo karaa dhihaa irraan gara kaabaatti deebi’e, rooba naanoo Eblaatiin booda. ammas laga Maaraa qaxxaamuruudhaan.
eng_text: And then back to the north through the west, once again crossing the Mara river, after the rains in around April.

text: Naannoon Serengetii paarkii biyyaalessaa Serengeti qaba, Naannoo Bakka eegumsaa Ngorongoro akkasumas Bakka Kunuunsa Taphaa Maswa Taanzaniyaatii fi Keeniyatti ammo Bakka Kunuunsaa Maasai Mara hammata.
eng_text: The Serengeti region contains the Serengeti National Park, the Ngorongoro Conservation Area and Maswa Game Reserve in Tanzania and the Maasai Mara National Reserve in Kenya.

text: Akkaataa midiiyaan salphaatti ittiin waln qunnamaamu uumamu baruun ogummaawwan ammayyawwa fi aadaa beekuu barbaada, akkasumaas meeshotaa baayee beekamoo kan kutaawwan itti wal qunnamamu (Bakkabarreeffamaa seena, sagalee fi suur-sagalee qindessu, seenaa himuu, fi kkf.)
eng_text: Learning to create interactive media requires conventional and traditional skills, as well as tools mastered in interactive classes (storyboarding, audio and video editing, story telling, etc.)

text: Saxaxin haasoo tilmaami waayee oomisha miidiyaa kee irra deebiin akka ilaaltuu fi karaa baratameen ala akka yaaduu bartu barbaada
eng_text: Interactive design requires that you re-assess your assumptions about media production and learn to think in a non-linear ways.

text: Dizaayiniin waliifgalaa qaamotni pirojektii tokkon tokkoon isanii walitti hidhachuu isaanii, garuu immoo qofa qofaa isaaniis yoo ta’an hiikaa kennuu isaanii barbaada.
eng_text: Interactive design requires that components of a project connect to each other, but also make sense as a separate entity.

text: Miidhaan leensota guddisoo walxaxiinsa xiyyeefannoo fi lakkoofsi elementiiwwan leensii dheerinoota fookaalii hedduu argachuuf barbaadamuu kan leensoota piraayimii caalaa guddaadha.
eng_text: The disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the focal complexity and number of lens elements required to achieve a range of focal lengths is much greater than for prime lenses.

text: Oomishtoonni leensii oomisha leensii keessatti milkaa’ina guddaarra ga’aa yemmuu deeman wanti kun mata duree cimaa ta’uun isaa hafaa dhufaa jira.
eng_text: This is becoming less of an issue as lens manufacturers achieve higher standards in lens production.

text: Kuni leensonni guddisoon suuraawwan sadarkaa isaanii eegan kanneen lensoota ilaalcha xiyyeefanno dheerinni isaa murtaa’e qaban waliin walmadaalan oomishuu isaan dandeessiseejira.
eng_text: This has allowed zoom lenses to produce pictures of a quality comparable to that achieved by lenses with fixed focal length.

text: Miidhaan leensii guddisee agarsiisuu adda biran isaa baniinsi olaanaa (ariitiin) leensichaa yeroo hedduu suuta jedhaadha.
eng_text: Another disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the maximum aperture (the speed) of the lens is usually lower.

text: Kuni bakka ibsaan xiqqoo ta’etti leensii guddiftee muldhiftuuu rakasaa, ibsaa harkaa malee itti fayyadamuuf ulfaataa taasisa.
eng_text: This makes inexpensive zoom lenses hard to use in low-light conditions without a flash.

text: Rakkoowwan beekamoo gaafa fiilmii gara DVDtti jijjiiran jiru keessaa inni tokko humnaa ol iskaanii gochuudha .
eng_text: One of the most common problems when trying to convert a movie to DVD format is the overscan.

text: Teleevizhiniin hedduun akka uumataa bal’aa gammachiisuuf ta'aaniti dhaabatu.
eng_text: Most televisions are made in a way to please the general public.

text: Sabaaba sanaaf, wantootni ati TV irrati ilaaltu hundi daangaa kutu, gubbaa, jalaa fi bukke qaban
eng_text: For that reason, everything you see on the TV had the borders cut, top, bottom and sides.

text: Kun suurichi guutuu iskiriinii akka haguuge mirkaneessuuf kan tolfameedha. Sun garmalee iskaan gochuu jedhama.
eng_text: This is made to ensure that the image covers the whole screen. That is called overscan.

text: Akka carraa ta’uu didee, yeroo DVD toolchitu, xiyyoon isaas muramuu hin haafu, yoo vidiyochi barreeffama jalatti siqee jiru qabaate immoo, gutummaan guutuutti hin mul’atu.
eng_text: Unfortunately, when you make a DVD, it's borders will most likely be cut too, and if the video had subtitles too close to the bottom, they won't be fully shown.

text: Masaraan aadaa warra bara gidduu-galeessaa ilaalcha wal’aansoo goototaa, kan nyaachisa guddaa, akkasumas sirna gootummaa Artar akka sammuu namaa keessatti uumamaniif kaka’umsa uumanii jiru.
eng_text: The traditional medieval castle has long inspired the imagination, conjuring up images of jousts, banquets and Arthurian chivalry.

text: Hurraa wagga kuma lakkoofsise keessa iyyuu dhaabbatanii, kottee fardeenii dhagaa afamaarraa dhaga’uun fi sodaa boolla dahannoo keessaa ol aaru suufuun, sagalee fi foolii waraana dur durii gara sammuu ofiitti fiduun salphaadha.
eng_text: Even standing amidst thousand year-old ruins it is easy to bring to mind the sounds and smells of battles long gone, to almost hear the clatter of hooves on the cobbles and to smell the fear rising from the dungeon pits.

text: Garuu ilaalchaa yaada keenya dha dhugaa irratti kan hundaa’e? jalqabumaatiyu maaliif manni mootoots ijaarame? Akkamin kafamanii ijaaramanii?
eng_text: But is our imagination based on reality? Why were castles built in the first place? How were they designed and built?

text: Yeroo sanaa baay’ee beekamaa kan ta’e, Masaraan Kerbii Maaksiloo’ii masarummaa dhugaa caalaa akka waan mana dahannooti.
eng_text: Typical for the period, Kirby Muxloe Castle is more of a fortified house than a true castle.

text: Foddaan isaa babal’aanii fi keenyan isaa haphiin yeroo dheeraadhaaf haleellaa cimaa ofirraa ittisuu hindanda’an turan.
eng_text: Its large glazed windows and thin walls would not have been able to resist a determined attack for long.

text: Bara 1480moota keessa, yeroo ijaarsi isaa Goofta Hastiingisiin jalqabame, biyyattiin giddu naga-qabeettii turte, akkasumas ittisni kan barbaachisu gaafa balaa geessistoonni garee xiqqoo dhufan qofa ture.
eng_text: In the 1480s, when its construction was begun by Lord Hastings, the country was relatively peaceful and defense was only required against small bands of roving marauders.

text: Madaalliin humnaa mala biyyoonni Awurooppaa birmadummaa biyyaalessaa biyyoota Awurooppaa hundaa ittiin eeguuf barbaadan ture.
eng_text: The balance of power was a system in which European nations sought to maintain the national sovereignty of all European states.

text: Yaad-rimichi biyyootni Awuroppaan hundi biyya tokko akka humna hin qabaannee dhorkuuniifi motummaaleen biyolleessaas madaala isaani eeguuf michooma isaanii yeroo baay’ee jijiruu isaanii ture.
eng_text: The concept was that all European nations had to seek to prevent one nation from becoming powerful, and thus national governments often changed their alliances in order to maintain the balance.

text: Lolli Dhaaltummmaa Ispeenotaa yeroo jalqabaaf kan galma ga’e dhimma giddu galaa aangoo ittiin madaalchisuuti.
eng_text: The War of Spanish Succession marked the first war whose central issue was the balance of power.

text: Kuni akka jijjiirama guddaatti fudhatama, humnoonni Awuroppa amma booda waraana amantaa kaasuuf jecha-duraa hin qaban. kanaaf, Waraanni Waggaa Soddomaa waraana amantaa isaa dhumaa kan jedhamu ta’a.
eng_text: This marked an important change, as European powers would no longer have the pretext of being religious wars. Thus, the Thirty Years' War would be the last war to be labeled a religious war.

text: Gamoon waaqeffannaa Arxeemis inni Efesas keessaa gocha ibidda itti qabsiisuu Heeroosxiraatasiin raawwatameen dhaloota Kiristoos dura, Adoolessa 21, bara 356 balleeffame.
eng_text: The temple of Artemis at Ephesus was destroyed on July 21, 356 BCE in an act of arson committed by Herostratus.

text: Akkaataa seenaatiin, kaka’umsi isaa gatii kamiinuu beekamtii dha. Warri Efesiyaa, hedduu dheekkamanii,maqaan Herostraatos yoomiyyuu akka hin galmoofne ibsa kennanii jiru.
eng_text: According to the story, his motivation was fame at any cost. The Ephesians, outraged, announced that Herostratus' name never be recorded.

text: Qorataa seenaa Giriik Stiraaboo’tu booda maqaa nuuti hardha jennu hubate. Manni qulqullummichaa halkanuma Aleksaander Guddichi dhalate barbadaa’e.
eng_text: The Greek historian Strabo later noted the name, which is how we know today. The temple was destroyed on the same night that Alexander the Great was born.

text: Alegzaandar, akka mootiitti, gamoon waaqeffannaa sun akka irra-deebi’ee ijaaramuuf kaffaluuf dhiyeessee turee, garuu kennaan isaa fudhatama hin arganne. Booda, erga Alegzaandar du’ee, gamoon waaqeffannaa sun dhaloota Kiristoos dura bara 323 keessa deebi’ee ijaarame.
eng_text: Alexander, as king, offered to pay to rebuild the temple, but his offer was denied. Later, after Alexander died, the temple was rebuilt in 323 BCE.

text: Furtuuwwan hunda sirriitti yeroo rukuttu hanga danda’ametti harka kee laaffisuu kee mirkaneeffadhu—kana malees quboota keetiin sochii garmalee darbaa ta’e akka hingooneef yaali.
eng_text: Make sure your hand is as relaxed as possible while still hitting all the notes correctly - also try not to make much extraneous motion with your fingers.

text: Haala kanaan, hanga danda’ametti suuta suuta of dadhabsiista. Yaadadhu, akka piyaanoorrattii sagalee dabalataatiif furtuuwwan humna guddaadhaan rukutuun hinbarbaachisu.
eng_text: This way, you will tire yourself out as little as possible. Remember there's no need to hit the keys with a lot of force for extra volume like on the piano.

text: Akoordiyoonicha irratti, sagalee dabalataa argachuuf, dhibbaa ykn saffisa dabalataatiin buufaawwan fayyadamtu.
eng_text: On the accordion, to get extra volume, you use the bellows with more pressure or speed.

text: Mistisizimiin fedha walitti ta’uumsa , enyummaa wajjiin, dhugaa guddaa jiruu hamma dhumaatti hubachuu, uumaa, haaqa afuuraa yookiin Waaqa, waliin qabaachuudha.
eng_text: Mysticism is the pursuit of communion with, identity with, or conscious awareness of an ultimate reality, divinity, spiritual truth, or God.

text: Amanaan dhugaa Waaqaa/waaqa yookaan waaqolii beekuuf muuxannoo kallattii, akkasumatti dafanii baruu, yookaan keessa ofiitti beekuu barbaada.
eng_text: The believer seeks a direct experience, intuition, or insight into divine reality/the deity or dieties.

text: Duuka butootni haala jireenya murtaa’e, yookiin shaakala amala kana bocaa qabsiisu irratti xiyyeeffate.
eng_text: Followers pursue certain ways of living, or practices that are intended to nurture those experiences.

text: Miistiisiizimin gosoota amantaafi waaaqefannaa biroo irraa muuxannoo kallattii kan haala dammaqina addaa, kessumaa amala naga-qabeessa, hubannaan guute, gammachuun guute, yookaan mirqaanaanumaan illee guute irratti xiyyeeffachuu isaatiin adda baha.
eng_text: Mysticism can be distinguished from other forms of religious belief and worship by its emphasis on the direct personal experience of a unique state of consciousness, particularly those of a peaceful, insightful, blissful, or even ecstatic character.

text: Siikhisimiin amantaa kan ardii Indiyaanota isa xiqqoo irraati. Maddi isaas naannoo Punjaabi jaarraa 15ffaa keessa adaan Hinduu keessatti yeroo gareen gargar cabuuti.
eng_text: Sikhism is a religion from the Indian sub-continent. It originated in the Punjab region during the 15th century from a sectarian split within the Hindu tradition.

text: ‘Sikh’oonni amantaan isaanii kan Hinduyiizimii irraa akka adda ta’etti ilaalu, yooma Hinduu irraa dhufuu isaa fi aadaa Hinduu ta’uu isaa amanan iyyuu.
eng_text: Sikhs consider their faith to be a separate religion from Hinduism though they acknowledge its Hindu roots and traditions.

text: Sikhisiin amantaa isaanii Gurmaat jedhu, kunis afaan Punjaabii “ karaa warra guuruu” jechuuti. Guuruun amantaa Indiyaanotaa hundaaf wanta bu’uura ta’ee dha garuu Sikhisimii keessatti barbaachisummaa keessoo amantaa sikhii kan uume qabate.
eng_text: Sikhs call their religion Gurmat, which is Punjabi for "way of the guru". The guru is a fundamental aspect of all Indian religions but in Sikhism has taken on an importance that forms the core of Sikh beliefs.

text: Amantichi jaarraa 15ffaa (1469-1539) keessa Guuruu Naanaakiin hundeeffame. Sana booda guurota sagaltu walduraa-duubaan isa hordofe.
eng_text: The religion was founded in the 15th century by Guru Nanak (1469–1539). There followed in succession a further nine gurus.

text: Haa ta’uu iyyuu malee, Waxabajjii 1956 keessa, waadaawwan Kirushchev gara qorumsaati darbani turani Poland keessatti, yeroo hojjetootni hanqina nyaata fi kutamu mindaaf falma turan, Sanaa booda mormii Komiiniwuzimitti guddate akkuma biyyaati.
eng_text: However, in June 1956, Krushchev's promises were put to the test when riots in Poland, where workers were protesting against food shortages and wage cuts, turned into a general protest against Communism.

text: Yoomallee dhumarratti, tasgabbii iddootti deebisuuf Kirusheev taankii ergellee, inni dantaa dinagdee muraasaaf karaa banee namni fudhatamaa bal’aa qabu, Wilaadislaaw Gomulkaan muummee ministeeraa haaraa godhee akka muudu waliif-gale.
eng_text: Although in the end, Krushchev sent in tanks to restore order, he did give way to some economic demands and agreed to appoint the popular Wladyslaw Gomulka as the new prime minister.

text: Qaroominni Sulula Induus ardii xiqqaa Kaaba-lixa indiyaa keessati qaroomina bara baayyee lakkoofsisedha Afgaanistaan bara kanaafi Kaaba lixa Indiyaa keessa muraasaafi Kaaba-baha Afgaanistaan dabalatee.
eng_text: The Indus Valley Civilization was a Bronze Age civilisation in the northwest Indian subcontinent encompassing most of modern-day Pakistan and some regions in northwest India and northeast Afghanistan.

text: Qaroominni sulula laga indus irratti kan dagaage bakka sanaas maqaa isaa argate.
eng_text: The civilisation flourished in the basins of the Indus River wherefore it derives its name.

text: Yoodhumaa qorattootni muraasni qaroominichi sulula amma gogee kan laga Saraasvati keessas tureera jedhaniyyuu, kan inni jedhamee waamamuu qabu Qaroomina Indus-Saraasvati, yeroo muraasni Qaroomina Harapaan jedhani waaman Harapaa booddee, bakki itti argama isaa irraa kan jalqabaa qotame ba’e 1920 keessa.
eng_text: Although some scholars speculate that since the civilisation also existed in the basins of the now dried up Sarasvati River, it should be aptly called the Indus-Sarasvati Civilization, while some call it the Harappan Civilization after Harappa, the first of its sites to be excavated in the 1920s.

text: Akkuma guddinni dinagdee San Firaansiskoo harkisa tuuristii akka addunyaatti beekamaa irratti hundaa’e, dinagdeen ishee bal’aa dha.
eng_text: While San Francisco's economy is linked to it being a world-class tourist attraction, its economy is diversified.

text: Seektarii qaccari inni guddaan tajaajiloota piroofeshinaala, mootummaa, Faayinaansi, daldalaa, fi tuuriziimii dha.
eng_text: The largest employment sectors are professional services, government, finance, trade, and tourism.

text: Muuziqaa, fiilmiiwwan, og-barruu fi aadaa bal’inaan beekaman keessatti irra-deddeebiin of mul’isuun isii magaalattiinii fi bakkeewwan bebbeekamoon isii keessaa akka guutummaa addunyaatti beekamaniif gargaaree jira.
eng_text: Its frequent portrayal in music, films, literature and popular culture has helped make the city and its landmarks known throughout the world.

text: Saan Firaansiskoon misooma daawwattotaa guddaa hoteelota, restoraantiiwwanii fi galmawwan walga’ii qulqullina olaanaa qaban hedduu ijaartee jirti.
eng_text: San Francisco has developed a large tourist infrastructure with numerous hotels, restaurants, and top-notch convention facilities.

text: San Firaansiiskoonis bakkeewwan biyyattii nyaata-aadaa Eeshiyaa kan biroo qaban keessaa tokko: Kan Kooriyaa, kan Taayilaand, kan Indiyaa fi Jaapaan.
eng_text: San Francisco is also one of the best places in the nation for other Asian cuisine: Korean, Thai, Indian, and Japanese.

text: Gara Woolti Diiznii Woorliditti imaluun maatiiwwan Ameerikaa hedduudhaaf jila guddaa bakka bu’a.
eng_text: Traveling to Walt Disney World represents a major pilgrimage for many American families.

text: Do’annaan "baratamaan," Buufata Xiyyaaraa Idil-addunyaa Orlaandoo’tti balali’uu, gara bakka-hojii hoteela Disnii’tti baasii qabachuu, qabeenyaa Disnii utuu gad-hin dhiisin naannoo torban tokkoo achitti dabarsuu, achii manatti deebi’uu of keessatti hammata.
eng_text: The "typical" visit involves flying into Orlando International Airport, busing to an on-site Disney hotel, spending about a week without leaving Disney property, and returning home.

text: Adda addummaa hedduu dhuma hin qabnetu jira, garuu kun waan namoonni hedduu jechuu barbaadanii dha gaafa waa’ee “gara Addunyaa Ashangulitii deemna jedhan”.
eng_text: There are infinite variations possible, but this remains what most people mean when they talk of "going to Disney World".

text: Tikeetonni baayyeen toora interneetaarraan caalbaasiin karaa marsariitiiwwan akka iiBeey yookaan Kireegliistiin gurguraman tikeettota park hooppar guyya-baaayyee walakkaan fayadamamanidha.
eng_text: Many tickets sold online through auction websites such as eBay or Craigslist are partially used multi-day park-hopper tickets.

text: Kun sochii baay’ee baratamaa ta’ee utuma jiruu, Dizniidhaan dhorkamaadha: tikeeticha nama biraatti dabarsuun hin danda’amu.
eng_text: While this is a very common activity, it is prohibited by Disney: the tickets are non-transferable.

text: Grand Canyon keessatti kampii qopheessun eeyyamaa biyya-duubaanii barbaada.
eng_text: Any camping below the rim in Grand Canyon requires a backcountry permit.

text: Sululicha eeguu jechahayyama muraasa qofatu kennama, ji’a inni itti eegalu ji’oottan afur dursee kan jalqaba ji’ichaa irratti argaman.
eng_text: Permits are limited to protect the canyon, and become available on the 1st day of the month, four months prior to the start month.

text: Kanaaf, hayyami baadiyyaa jiraattota muraasa qabuu, kan Caamsaa keessaa guyyaa itti jalqaban kamiiyyuu Amajjii 1 dhiyeeffama.
eng_text: Thus, a backcountry permit for any start date in May becomes available on 1 Jan.

text: Iddoon bakkeewwan hunda caalaa beekamoo, kanneen akka Bakkee Buufataa Biraayit Eenjel isa Faantam Raanchii cinaa, akka waliigalaatti guyyaama buufataaf banamoo ta’anii eegalanii gaaffiiwwan namootarraa dhufaniin guutu.
eng_text: Space for the most popular areas, such as the Bright Angel Campground adjacent to Phantom Ranch, generally fill up by the requests received on first date they are opened to reservations.

text: Eyyamaa murtaa’etu jira kan namaa duraa dhufeef kennamu seera kan duraa dhufee, duraa tajaajilamaa jedhuun.
eng_text: There are a limited number permits reserved for walk-in requests available on a first come, first served basis.

text: Afriikaa kibbaa konkoolaataan galuun bareedina naannolee fi daandii daawwattootaan baratamoo ta’an ala jiran ilaaluuf karaa dinqisiisaa dha.
eng_text: Entering Southern Africa by car is an amazing way to see all the region's beauty as well as to get to places off the normal tourist routes.

text: Kunis kan godhamu danda’u makiina nagaa keessatti karoora sirriitin garuu 4x4 kan baayee gorfamuu dha fi bakkotni hedduun kan isaan dhaqabaman makiinota gooma ol ka’oo qaban 4x4’ni.
eng_text: This can be done in a normal car with careful planning but a 4x4 is highly advised and many locations are only accessible with a high wheel base 4x4.

text: Sammuuti qabadhu yeroo sana karoorsitu akka Afriikan kibba tasgabooftuu hin taane biyyootni ollaa biroon illee hin miti.
eng_text: Keep in mind while planning that although Southern Africa is stable not all neighboring countries are.

text: Ulaagaan Viizaadhaf barbaachisu biyyaa biyyatti adda addadha, akkasumas biyya ati irraa dhufte irratti kan hunda’uu dha.
eng_text: Visa requirements and costs vary from nation to nation and are affected by the country you come from.

text: Biyyootni tokkoon tokkoon isaanii seerota meeshaalee hatattamaa konkolaataa keessa ta’uu qaban irratti seera adda addaa qabu.
eng_text: Each country also has unique laws requiring what emergency items need to be in the car.

text: Viiktooriyaa Foolsi magaalaa dhiha Zimbabuweetti argamtu dha, daangaawwan Livingiston, Zaambiyaarra, Botsiwaanaatti dhiyaatteea.
eng_text: Victoria Falls is a town in the western portion of Zimbabwe, across the border from Livingstone, Zambia, and near Botswana.

text: Magaalichi fincaa’aawwanumatti aanee argama, isaanisa hawwata qalbii namaa gugddoodha, garuu bakkeen hawwata tuuristii beekamtuun kun namoonni muuxannoo addaafi sodaachisaa qabaachuu barbaadaniifi kanneen daawwatan yeroo dheeraaf akka turaniif caarraa hedduu dhiyeessaaf.
eng_text: The town lies immediately next to the falls, and they are the major attraction, but this popular tourist destination offers both adventure seekers and sightseers plenty of opportunities for a longer stay.

text: Waqtii roobaa keessa (Sadaasaa hanga Bitootessaatti), qabiyyeen bishaanii ol ka’a, Fincaa’aawwan immoo daran saffisa godhatu.
eng_text: In the rainy season (November to March), the water volume will be higher and the Falls will be more dramatic.

text: Yoo riqicha qaxxaamurtan wabii jiidhuu qabdan yookaan gara kallattii bubbee Fincaa’aa cinaatti deemaa.
eng_text: You are guaranteed to get wet if you cross the bridge or walk along the trails winding near the Falls.

text: Karaa biraatiin, sirriitti sababa qabiyyeen bishaanii baayyee olka’aa ta’eef ilaalchikee fincaa’aa isa sirrii si jalaa dhokata—hunduma bishaaniin!
eng_text: On the other hand, it is precisely because the volume of water is so high that your viewing of the actual Falls will be obscured—by all the water!

text: Awwalchii Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 awwalchaa suululiicha keessatti argaman keessaa baayee beekamaa ta’uu mala, kutaa agarsiisa Hoowaard kaarterii kan bara 1922 argaameef kan moototni dargaagoon itti awwalaaman keessa dha.
eng_text: Tomb of Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 may be the most famous of the tombs in the Valley, the scene of Howard Carter's 1922 discovery of the almost intact royal burial of the young king.

text: Yeroo awwaalchaa warree mootata waliin wal biraa qabamuu, haa ta’uuyyu malee, awwalchii Tutankahamun baayee kan dawwatamuu dha, yooma baayee xiqqoo ta’eef kan xiqqoo qofaa babbareechamee yoo ta’eele.
eng_text: Compared to most of the other royal tombs, however, the tomb of Tutankhamun is barely worth visiting, being much smaller and with limited decoration.

text: Namni ragaa midhaa reeffa tursame irra ga’e yeroo saaxinii keessaa baasuf yaalaa turametti ta’e ilaalu barbaadu mataa fi gateettii qofaan waan mul’atuuf mufachuunsaa hin oolu.
eng_text: Anyone interested in seeing evidence of the damage to the mummy done during attempts to remove it from the coffin will be disappointed as only the head and shoulders are visible.

text: Qabeenyaan bakkee awwaalaa sana keessa jira jedhamee dubbatamaa ture amma achi keessa hinjiru, garuu gara Muuziyeemii Masir isa Kaayiroo keessaatti geeffamee jira.
eng_text: The fabulous riches of the tomb are no longer in it, but have been removed to the Egyptian Museum in Cairo.

text: Daawwattoonni yeroo muraasa qaban bakkee biraatti osoo yeroo isaanii dabarsanii filatama.
eng_text: Visitors with limited time would be best to spend their time elsewhere.

text: Phinoom Kiroomin, Km 12 kibbadhiiha Sii’eemi Ripii irraa. Manni Qulqullummaa fiixee gaaraa kun dhuma jaarraa 9ffaa kessa ijaarame. Yeroo bulchiinsa Mootii Yaasoovarmaan.
eng_text: Phnom Krom, 12 km southwest of Siem Reap. This hilltop temple was built at the end of the 9th century, during the reign of King Yasovarman.

text: Haalli dukkanaa’aan mana qulqullummaa sanaatii fi mul’uun haroo Toonlii Saap irraan qaari’aanii argan yaabbii tulluchaa barbaachisaa godhu.
eng_text: The gloomy atmosphere of the temple and the view over the Tonle Sap lake make the climb to the hill worthwhile.

text: Daawwannaan bakkee sanaa haala mijataa ta’een imala bidiruudhaan gara galaanichaatti godhamu waliin walitti dabalamuu danda’a.
eng_text: A visit to the site can be conveniently combined with a boat trip to the lake.

text: Darbiinsi Aangikoor gara mana mootummatti seenuuf nii barbaachisaa kanaaf paasporti kee Toonlii Saap waliin fidee dhufuu hin dagaatin.
eng_text: The Angkor Pass is needed to enter the temple so do not forget to bring your passport along when heading to Tonle Sap.

text: Biyyoonni biroo hedduu fi Dhabbanni Mootummoota Gamtoomanii akka teessoo mootummaa Israa’elitti beekamtii kennuu baatanis Iyyeruusaalem magaala guddoo fi teessoo mootummaa Israa’eliiti
eng_text: Jerusalem is the capital and largest city of Israel, though most other countries and the United Nations do not recognize it as Israel's capital.

text: Magaalaan bara durii Gaarreen Juudaa keessaa seenaa hawwataa baroota kumaatamaa qabdi.
eng_text: The ancient city in the Judean Hills has a fascinating history spanning thousands of years.

text: Magaalattiin amantaawwan Waaqa tokko irratti hunda’an sadaniif magaalaa qulqullittiidha– Juudaayizimii, Kiiristaanummaa fi Islaama, akkasumas akka giddugala hafuuraa, amantaa, fi aadaatti fayyaddi.
eng_text: The city is holy to the three monotheistic religions - Judaism, Christianity and Islam, and serves as a spiritual, religious, and cultural center.

text: Sababa barbaachisummaa amantaa magaalattiin, keessattuu iddoowwan baay’ee naannoo Magaalaa Durii’f jecha, Yeruusaalem bakkee daawwattoonni itti baay’atan keessaa ishee tokkoodha.
eng_text: Due to the religious significance of the city, and in particular the many sites of the Old City area, Jerusalem is one of the main tourist destinations in Israel.

text: Yerusaaleem bakkeewwan seenaa, arki’oolojii fi adaa hedduu, akkasumas bakkeewwan ho’ituu bittaa fi gurgurtaa , mana bunaa fi mana nyaataa namni itti baay’atu qabdi.
eng_text: Jerusalem has many historic, archeological and cultural sites, along with vibrant and crowded shopping centers, cafés, and restaurants.

text: Ikuwaadoor lammiileen Kuubaa karaalee buufata xiyyaaraa idil-addunyaatiinis ta’e karaalee ittiin daangaa hayyamaan seenaniin Ikuwaadooriin seenuun dura xalayaa afeerraa fudhachuu isaan irraa eegdi.
eng_text: Ecuador requires that Cuban citizens receive an invitation letter prior to entering Ecuador through international airports or frontier admission points.

text: Xalayaan kun Ministeera Dhimma Alaa Ikuwaadoor’n seera qabeessa taasifamuu fi ulaagaawwan tokko tokko guutuu qaba.
eng_text: This letter must be legalized by the Ecuadorian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and comply with certain requirements.

text: Haaldureen kun kan qajeelfameef biyyoota lamaan gidduutti sochii godaansaa qindaa’aa ta’e uumuufidha.
eng_text: These requirements are designed to provide an organized migratory flow between both countries.

text: Lammiiwwan Kuubaa kanneen giriin kaardii US qaban ulaagaa kana akka hingaafatamneef waajjira Qoonsilaa Ikuwaadoor quunnamuu qabu.
eng_text: Cuban citizens who are US green card holders should visit an Ecuadorian Consulate to obtain an exemption to this requirement.

text: Paaspoortiin kee guyyoota imalaa keerra darbee yoo xiqqaate ji’a 6 oliif kan hojjetu ta’uu qaba.. Tikeetiin ittiin deebii dheerina yeroo ati turtuu mirkaneessuuf ni barbaachisa.
eng_text: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months beyond your travel dates. A round/onward trip ticket is needed to prove the length of your stay.

text: Imalli garee guddaaf rakasa dha, kanaafu yoo kophaa taate ykn hiriyaa tokko qofa wajjiin taate, namoota biroo waliin qunnamu yaaliitii gatii dhuunfaa wayya’aaf garee afurii hanga ja’a uumi.
eng_text: Tours are cheaper for larger groups, so if you're by yourself or with just one friend, try to meet other people and form a group of four to six for a better per-person rate.

text: Haa ta’u malee, kun dhugaatti yaaddoo kee ta’uu hin qabu, sabaabiinsaas yeroo hedduu tuuristoonni naannoo sana wal jala darbu konkolaataa guutuuf.
eng_text: However, this shouldn't really be off your concern, because often tourists are shuffled around to fill the cars.

text: Dhugumaanuu kan fakkaatu haala irra caalaan namoonni dabalataan akka kaffalan amansiisuuf gowoomsuu dha.
eng_text: It seems actually to be more a way of tricking people into believing they have to pay more.

text: Ol gara dhumaa kaaba Machu Picchu dheeratee kan argamu gaarai gadi-ilaalaa kana, yeroo hedduu duuba suuraalee isaa akka caccabaa onaati.
eng_text: Towering above the north end of Machu Picchu is this steep mountain, often the backdrop to many photos of the ruins.

text: Gara gadiidha gaafa ilaalamu waan salphaati darbamu hin fakkatu, fi baayee ol ka’aa dha fi qooqa cimaa, garuu namootni gitaan daqiiqa 45 keessatti xumuru danda’u.
eng_text: It looks a bit daunting from below, and it is a steep and difficult ascent, but most reasonably fit persons should be able to make it in about 45 minutes.

text: Gulantaandhagaa harka caalaa daandichaarra kaka’ameera, akkasumas shiboon sibilaa karaa gulaantaa irratti akka gargartuu gulaantati kaa’ameera.
eng_text: Stone steps are laid along most of the path, and in the steeper sections steel cables provide a supporting handrail.

text: Sun erga jedhamee, hafuura baafachuu dadhabuueegi, akkasumas bakka baay’ee irraangadee eeggadhu, keessattu yeroo jidhaa ta’uu, inni gara waan hamaatti dafee jijjiiramuu waan danda’uuf.
eng_text: That said, expect to be out of breath, and take care in the steeper portions, especially when wet, as it can become dangerous quickly.

text: Irra isaatti dhiyaatee holqa xiqqootu jira kan keessa darbamu qabu, baayee gadi jedhadha baayees kan walitti qabudha.
eng_text: There's a tiny cave near the top that must be passed through, it is quite low and a rather tight squeeze.

text: Akkuma Chaarles Daarwiin bara 1835’tti godhe, bakkeewwan hawwatoo fi bineensota naannoo Gaalaapaagos ilaaluun sirriitti kan ta’u bidiruudhaani.
eng_text: Seeing the sites and wildlife of the Galapagos is best done by boat, just as Charles Darwin did it in 1835.

text: Dooniiwwan saffisa giddugalaatiin deeman 60 ol tu bishaan Galaapaagoos irra darba- guddinaan kanneen imaltoota 8 hanga 100 tti kanqabataniitti.
eng_text: Over 60 cruise ships ply the Galapagos waters - ranging in size from 8 to 100 passengers.

text: Namootni baay’een bakka isaanii dursa qabatu ( dooniin waqtii cimaatti yeroo baay’ee ni guutu).
eng_text: Most people book their place well in advance (as the boats are usually full during the high season).

text: Bakka bu’aa inni ati karaa isaa galmooftu ogeessa Galaapaagoos, isa beekumsa gaarii dooniiwwan hedduu irratti qabu akka ta’e mirkaneeffadhu.
eng_text: Be sure the agent through whom you book is a Galapagos specialist with a good knowledge of a wide variety of ships.

text: Kun fedhiin/ykn mamiin kee addaa doonii hunda caalaa isaaniif mijatu waliin malitti firoomuu isaanii mirkaneessa.
eng_text: This will ensure that your particular interests and/or constraints are matched with the ship most suitable to them.

text: Osoo jaarraa 16ffaa keessa ummanni Ispaanish hin dhufin dura, Chiiliin kaabaa bulchiinsa Inkaa jala yeroo turtetti dhalattoonni Arookaaniyaa (Mapuche) walakkaa fi kibba Chiilii qabattee turte.
eng_text: Before the Spanish arrived in the 16th century, northern Chile was under Inca rule while the indigenous Araucanians (Mapuche) inhabited central and southern Chile.

text: Mapuchen iyyuu gartuulee Amerikaa biyya keessaa isaan dhuma irratti bilisooman keessaa tokko kan turte, hanga bilisummaa Chiiliitti guutummatti bittaa dubbattoota-Ispaanishiin hin liqinfamne ture.
eng_text: The Mapuche were also one of the last independent American indigenous groups, that were not fully absorbed into Spanish-speaking rule until after Chile's independence.

text: Chiiliin bilisumma ishee 1810 haa labsattuyyuu malee (waraanota Neepaaliyoon kan Ispeeniin mootummaa giddu galeessaa haboo qabu malee waggootaaf hanbise xumura argachiisuun), Ispeen irratti hanga 1818 tti guutummaatti injifannoon hin argamne.
eng_text: Although Chile declared independence in 1810 (amid the Napoleonic wars that left Spain without a functioning central government for a couple of years), decisive victory over the Spanish was not achieved until 1818.

text: Riippablikiin Doominiikaan (Ispeen: Riipabliikaa Doominikaanaa) biyyaa Kaariibiyaaniia kan walakkaa bahaa cittuu Hispaaniyoolaa isa Haayitii waliin qooddatu qabattee jirtudha.
eng_text: The Dominican Republic (Spanish: República Dominicana) is a Caribbean country that occupies the eastern half of the island of Hispaniola, which it shares with Haiti

text: Qarqara galaanaa cerrecha adii qabuu fi taa’umsa lafaa gaarreeniitti dabaluudhaan, biyyichi magaalaa Awurooppaa durii Ameerikota keessaa, kan amma kutaa Saantoo Doomingoo ta’eef akka manaati.
eng_text: Besides white sand beaches and mountain landscapes, the country is home to the oldest European city in the Americas, now part of Santo Domingo.

text: Oddola sanarra jalqaba gosoota Taínos fi Caribe tu jiraata ture. Gosi Caribe kun namoota afaan Arawaak dubbatan, kanneen dhaloota Kiristoos dura bara 10,000 keessa achi qubatan turan.
eng_text: The island was first inhabited by the Taínos and Caribes. The Caribes were an Arawakan-speaking people who had arrived around 10,000 BCE.

text: waggoota gabaabaa muraasa keessattidhufiinsa aloolattoota Awurooppaa hordofee, uummanni Tayinosi bittoota Ispeenin baay’inaan hir'atee ture.
eng_text: Within a few short years following the arrival of European explorers, the population of Tainos had significantly been reduced by the Spanish conquerors

text: Akka Fray Bartolome de las Kasaasiti (Tratado de las Indias) 1492 fi 1498 gidduti abuurtootni Ispeen Tayinoota naannoo 100,000 ajjeessani.
eng_text: Based on Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) between 1492 and 1498 the Spanish conquerors killed around 100,000 Taínos.

text: Jardín de la Unión. Bakki banana kun akka airiyeemitti gadaamii dubartootaa jaarraa-17ffaaf ijaarame, isa keessaa ijaarsa Templo de San Diego qofatu dhaabbatee hafe.
eng_text: Jardín de la Unión. This space was built as the atrium for a 17th-century convent, of which the Templo de San Diego is the sole surviving building.

text: Amma akka walakkeessa Plazaati tajaajilaa, fi yeroo hundumaa waan adeemu qabaa, guyyaa fi galgalaa.
eng_text: It now functions as the central plaza, and always has a lot of things going on, day and night.

text: Bakka magariisicha marsun mana nyaata hedduutu jira, fi waaree booda fi galgalaa Koonsartoota bilisaatu kennama walakkeessa gazebo dha.
eng_text: There are a number of restaurants surrounding the garden, and in the afternoons and evening there free concerts are often given from the central gazebo.

text: Kaalejoon del Beesoo (Xurree Dhungannaa). Baalkoniin lama seentimeetira 69 qofaan addaan ba’e mana goota jaalalaa beekamaa duriiti.
eng_text: Callejon del Beso (Alley of the Kiss). Two balconies separated by only 69 centimeters is home of an old love legend.

text: Qarshiiwwan muraasaf ijoollen muraasni seenaa isaa sitti in himu.
eng_text: For a few pennies some children will tell you the story.

text: Ayiislandiin Boween bakka imalaa guyyaa yookiin guyyoota torbee dhumaa beekamaa dha tajaajiloota kanneen akka kayaking, haayiking, suuqiiwwaani, mana nyaata, fi kan caalan qabachuun.
eng_text: Bowen Island is a popular day trip or weekend excursion offering kayaking, hiking, shops, restaurants, and more.

text: Hawaasni dhugaan kun Howe Saawund Vaankover keessaa akka bahame, keessatti argama; karaa taaksii bishaanii beellamaan oddoloa Granviil goda magaalaa Vaankooverii bahaniin salphaatti deemamuu ni danda’a.
eng_text: This authentic community is located in Howe Sound just off Vancouver, and is easily accessed via scheduled water taxis departing Granville Island in downtown Vancouver.

text: Isaan kan sochii mana alaa jaalatan, Kooridooriin Galaanaa hanga Samiin barbaachisaa dha.
eng_text: For those who enjoy outdoor activities, a trek up the Sea to Sky corridor is essential.

text: Wiisler (adeemsa konkolaataan Vaankoover irraa sa’aatii 1.5 fagaata) gatiinsa mi’aadha garuu sababa Olompikii Bonaa 2010’n baay’ee beekame.
eng_text: Whistler (1.5 hour drive from Vancouver) is expensive but well-known because of the 2010 Winter Olympics.

text: Bona keessa, mucucoo cabbii Ameeriikaa Kaabaa baay’ee gaggaarii tokko tokkotti gammadaa, akkasuma ganna immoo biskileettiidhaan gaara ba’uu isa dhugaasaa hanga tokko yaalaa.
eng_text: In the winter, enjoy some of the best skiing in North America, and in the summer try some authentic mountain biking.

text: Eeyyamni ga’aan dursee jiraachuu qabaa. Ati dirqama eeyyama qabaachuu qabda Sirenatti halkan guutuu turuudhaaf.
eng_text: Permits must be reserved in advance. You must have a permit to stay overnight at Sirena.

text: Sirenan dhabbata reenjarii tokkicha bakka ciisicha fi nyaata ho’aa bakka buufataatti dabalatan kennudha. La Leona, San Pedrillo, fi Los Patos nyaata malee bakka ciisichaa qofaa kenna.
eng_text: Sirena is the only ranger station that offers dormitory lodging and hot meals in addition to camping. La Leona, San Pedrillo, and Los Patos offer only camping with no food service.

text: Haayyama paarkingii Reenjeri buufata Poortoo Jimeenezii eegu irraa fudhachuun ni danda’ama, garuu kaardii liqaa hin fudhatan.
eng_text: It is possible to secure park permits directly from the Ranger Station in Puerto Jiménez, but they do not accept credit cards

text: Tajaajilli paarkii (MINAE) dhufaatii yaadame dursee ji’a tokkoo olitti eeyyema paarkii hin kennu.
eng_text: The Park Service (MINAE) does not issue park permits more than one month in advance of anticipated arrival.
