eng_text: CafeNet El Sol offers a reservation service for a fee of US$30, or $10 for one-day passes; details on their Corcovado page.

text: Ayislaandiin Cook ayislandoota bilisa kan walitti dhufeenya Niw Ziiland waliin, kan isheen itti argamtus Polineshiyati, garbaa kibbaa paasifikiiti argamti.
eng_text: The Cook Islands are an island country in free association with New Zealand, located in Polynesia, in the middle of the South Pacific Ocean.

text: Inni walitti qabama oddoloawwanii kanoddolawwan 15 kan galaana bal’ina Miliiyoona Kilomeetir iskuweer 2.2 qabuu irra hafamee jiru qabuudha.
eng_text: It is an archipelago with 15 islands spread out over 2.2 million km2 of ocean.

text: Hawaayii waliin zoonii sa’atii walfakkaatu keessaa jiraachuu isaaniitiin, cittuuwwan kunniin aal tokko tokko akka “Hawaayii down under” tti yaadamu.
eng_text: With the same time zone as Hawaii, the islands are sometimes thought of as "Hawaii down under".

text: Xiqqaa ta’us, daawattoota dulloomoo tokko tokkoo kan Hawaayiin osoo motummaa naannoo hin ta’iin dura fi hoteelotni tuuristootaa guguddoon hin jiraatin duraa isaan yaadachiisa.
eng_text: Though smaller, it reminds some elderly visitors of Hawaii before statehood without all the large tourist hotels and other development.

text: Lafti bilchaataan walakkaa bishaaniitti argamu magaala homaatuu hin qabu garuu lafa garagaraa 15 irraa kan uumameedha. Isaan gurguddoon Raarootoongaa fi Aytutaki.
eng_text: The Cook Islands do not have any cities but are composed of 15 different islands. The main ones are Rarotonga and Aitutaki.

text: Har’a biyyoota guddatan keessatti, siree baay’ee adda ta’ee fi cireen akka waan ulaagaa artiiti dhiyaataa jira.
eng_text: In developed countries today, providing deluxe bed and breakfasts has been raised to a sort of art-form.

text: Gra fiixee dhumaa irratti , B&B’ootaan kan beekamu irra caala wantoota lama irratti waldorgomu: siree tolchuu fi ciree qopheessuudha.
eng_text: At the top end, B&Bs obviously compete mainly on two main things: bedding and breakfast.

text: Kanarraa ka’uun, dhaabbiin akkasii yeroo baayyee gaarii irratti ciisiicha bareedaa akka argattuuf si gargaara, yoo ta’eef kan harkaan hojjetame ykn kan duriiti.
eng_text: Accordingly, at the finest such establishments one is apt to find the most luxurious bedding, maybe a handmade quilt or an antique bed.

text: Cireen nyaata naannichi waqtiidhaanii naannichaa yookaan nyaata addaa simataa saayinii of keessatti hammata.
eng_text: Breakfast may include seasonal delights of the region or the host's speciality dish.

text: Haalli teessumaa sun bakka seenaa ijaarsa dulloomaa kanneen meeshaalee teessumaa kan durii of keessaa qaban, bakka itti qeensa bareechatan,fi bakka bishaan daakan ta’uu mala.
eng_text: The setting might be an historic old building with antique furnishings, manicured grounds and a swimming pool.

text: Konkolaata mataa keetii keessa seentee deemsa karaa dheeraa deemuun salphaa ta’uu isaa keessa waan namatti tolutu jira.
eng_text: Getting into your own car and heading off on a long road trip has an intrinsic appeal in its simplicity.

text: Akka konkolaataawwan guguddoo utuu hin ta’in, tarii konkolaataa kee ofuufii fi hamma isaa beekuutti barteetta ta’a.
eng_text: Unlike larger vehicles, you are probably already familiar with driving your car and know its limitations.

text: Dunkaana qabeenya dhunfaa irratti ykn magaala hanga barbaadameyyuu keessatti dhaabbachuun ilaalcha hin malle harkiisuu danda’a.
eng_text: Setting up a tent on private property or in a town of any size can easily attract unwanted attention.

text: Gabaabumatti, konkolaataa kee fayyadamuun imala karaa godhuuf waan haalaan gaariidha, garuu ofii isaatiin yeroo muraasa karaa itti “yeroof qubatanidha”.
eng_text: In short, using your car is a great way to take a road trip but seldom in itself a way to "camp".

text: Makiina dhabuun ni danda’ama yoo minivanii qabaate, SUV, Sedan yookiin Wagon isteeshinii ta’umsi isaanii ciise.
eng_text: Car camping is possible if you have a large minivan, SUV, Sedan or Station Wagon with seats that lay down.

text: Hoteelonni tokko tokko bara warqee daandii baaguraa hurkaa irraa haftee qabu; waraana addunyaa lammaffaa dura, jaarraa 19ffaa yookaan jalqaba jaarraa 20ffaa.
eng_text: Some hotels have a heritage from the golden age of steam railways and ocean liners; before the Second World War, in the 19th or early 20th centuries.

text: Hoteelonni kun bakka beekamtoonni fi sooressoonni guyyaa turani ture, akkasumas yeroo baay’ee irbaata fi jiruu galgalaa gaarii qabaatu.
eng_text: These hotels were where the rich and the famous of the day would stay, and often had fine dining and nightlife.

text: Maxxansaaleen manarraa faashinii moofaan, hanqinni gaarummaa bakka tokkoo inni dhiyoon, fi dullumni simbo qabeessi hangi tokkos qaama amaloota isaaniiti.
eng_text: The old fashioned fittings, the lack of the latest amenities, and a certain graceful agedness are also part of their character.

text: Yooma yeroo baayee kan dhuunfataman ta’eeyyuu, isaan yeroo baayee akka mataa naannoo daawwatanif mijeessuuf akkasumas abbootii taayitaa biroo.
eng_text: While they are usually privately owned, they sometimes accommodate visiting heads of state and other dignitaries.

text: Imalaan maallaqa tuullaa qabu balali’a addunyaa gutuu, kan turtiiwwan hooteloota baay’ee kanneen keessaatti caccabuu dandan ilaalcha keessa galchuu mala.
eng_text: A traveller with piles of money might consider a round the world flight, broken up with stays in many of these hotels.

text: Walitti-hidhamiinsi gaarummaa wal jijjiiruu dhaabbata imaltoota magaalota isaan daawwachuuf deeman keessatti namoota naannoo waliin wal-quunnamsiisuudha.
eng_text: A hospitality exchange network is the organization that connects travelers with locals in the cities they are going to visit.

text: Neetwoorkii akkanaa walitti hidhuun yeroo hedduu unkaa toora intarneetiirraan guutuu qofa barbaachisa, neetwoorkiiwwan tokko tokko mirkaneessa dabalataa yoo dhiyeessan ykn barbaadan illee.
eng_text: Joining such a network usually just requires filling out an online form; although some networks offer or require additional verification.

text: Ergaasi tarreefamni keessummeesituu barreeffamaan fi/ykn marsariitiin kallattiin kennama, yeroo tokko tokkommoo ragaa waliin fi keessa deebii imaltootaan kennamuun ni godhama.
eng_text: A listing of available hosts is then provided either in print and/or online, sometimes with references and reviews by other travelers.

text: Imalli galaanarraa Amajjii 2004 yeroo sagantaa kompiwuutaraa Keesii Faantan balali’iinsa rakasaa galaanaa argatan, garuu itti turu hin qabnettu ture.
eng_text: Couchsurfing was founded in January 2004 after computer programmer Casey Fenton found a cheap flight to Iceland but did not have a place to stay.

text: Barattota Yuunivarsitii naannichaatti iimeeyilii ergee lakkoofsi barattoota bilisaan bakka buufaataa dhiiyeessuu barbaadanii hedduun isa ga’e.
eng_text: He emailed students at the local university and received an overwhelming number of offers for free accommodation.

text: Qopheessitoonni hoosteelii yeroo baayyee namoota umuriin ijoolleedha – gosoni keessummootaa warren umuriin digdamman kessaa jiranidha – garuu yeroo bayyee imaltoota umurniin deemanis argachuu dandeessa.
eng_text: Hostels cater primarily to young people – a typical guest is in their twenties – but you can often find older travellers there too.

text: Maatiiwwan ijoollee qaban darbanii darbanii argamu, garuu manneen ciisichaa muraasni kutaa dhuunfaa isaaniif ni eeyyamu.
eng_text: Families with children are a rare sight, but some hostels do allow them in private rooms.

text: Magaalaan Beejiing Chaayinaa keessaa magaalaa keessummeessituu Taphoota Olompikii Bonaa 2022ti, kan magaala yeroo jalqabaaf Olompikii Gannaa fi Olompikii Bonaa lamaanuu keessummeessite ishee godha.
eng_text: The city of Beijing in China will be the host city of the Olympic Winter Games in 2022, which will make it the first city to have hosted both the summer and winter Olympics.

text: Beejing sirna baninsaaf cufiinsaa qopheesiti akkasumaas qophee cabbii mana keessaa.
eng_text: Beijing will host the opening and closing ceremonies and the indoor ice events.

text: Agarsiisotni cabbie irraa fiigu adda biran Taizicheng ski naannoo Zhangjiakou, Beejing irra 220 km (140 maayilii).
eng_text: Other skiing events will be at the Taizicheng ski area in Zhangjiakou, about 220 km (140 miles) from Beijing.

text: Giddu galli iddoowwan waaqeffanna baay’een isaanii waggaatti feestivaali baatii dhuma Sadaasaa hanga walakkaa Caamsaatti, innis akkuma kaalendera mana waaqeffannichaatti hundaa’uun garaagara ta’a.
eng_text: Most of the temples do have an Annual festival starting from November end to Mid of May, which varies according to each temple's annual calendar.

text: Ayyanni mana amantaa baayeen akka ayyanneefanna waggaa amantatti kabaajama ykn kabajaa guyyaa dhaloota nyaatan ykn kabajaa addaa kan biroo kan mana amantaa waliin wal qabate.
eng_text: Most of the temple festivals is celebrated as part of temple's anniversary or presiding deity's birthday or any other major event associated with the temple.

text: Ayyaanni mana amantaa Keeraalaa ilaaluudhaaf baay’ee hawwataadha, agarsiisa dhaabbataa arba miidhagfamee, baandii mana amantaa fi ayyaanota biroottin midhagfamerea
eng_text: Kerala's temple festivals are very interesting to see, with regular procession of decorated elephants, temple orchestra and other festivities.

text: Gabaa Addunyaa (kan Agarsiisa Addunyaa ykn salphaamatti Ekispoo jedhamuun) feestivaala idil-addunyaa guddaa kan aartii fi saayinsiiwwaniiti.
eng_text: A World's Fair (commonly called World Exposition, or simply Expo) is large international festival of arts and sciences.

text: Biyyootni hirmaatan dhimmoota addunyaa yookiin aadaa fi seenaa biyya isaanii agarsiisuf galmawwan biyyoolessaa keessatti agarsiisawwan aartummaa qabanii fi barsiisoo ta’an dhiheessu.
eng_text: Participating countries present artistic and educational displays in national pavilions to showcase world issues or their country's culture and history.

text: Agarsiisni oomisha Abaaboo Idila-addunyaa taateewwan addaa kan agariisa biqilootaa biyyaa, maasii biqiloota qorannoo fi waan hafe kamiyyuu biqilaa waliin wal qabatu of-keessatti qabata.
eng_text: International Horticultural Expositions are specialised events which showcase floral displays, botanical gardens and anything else to do with plants.

text: Sadarkaa yaadaatti waggaa waggaadhaan raawwachuu haa danda’an iyyuu malee (hanga biyyoota garaa garaa keessa jiraatanitti), qabatamaadhaan garuu miti.
eng_text: Although in theory they can take place annually (so long as they are in different countries), in practice they are not.

text: Waltajiileen kunneen barteedhaan ji’a sadiif jaha gidduu kan turuu, fi bakkeewwan hektaara 50 gad hin taaneetti geggeeffamu.
eng_text: These events normally last anywhere between three and six months, and are held on sites no smaller than 50 hectares.

text: Waggoottan darban keessatti foormaatiiwwan fiilmii hedduu garaa garaatu dhimma itti ba’amaa as ga’e. Inni yeroo baay’ee dhimma itti ba’amu isa miiliimeetirii 35 baratamaadha (mm 36 mm 24n negatiiva).
eng_text: There are many different film formats that have been used over the years. Standard 35 mm film (36 by 24 mm negative) is much the commonest.

text: Yoo of-harkaa fixxe, inni yeroo baayyee haala salphaatti deebi’ee guutamuu danda’a, akkasumas qulqullina tilmaamaan DSLR ammaa waliin madaalamuu danda’u kenna
eng_text: It can usually be replenished fairly easily if you run out, and gives resolution roughly comparable to a current DSLR.

text: Kaameeraa format giddu galeessaa muraasni kan fayyadaman formaati 6 fi 6, sirriitti ibsuuf kan negatiiva 56 fi 56 mm fayyadaman.
eng_text: Some medium-format film cameras use a 6 by 6 cm format, more precisely a 56 by 56 mm negative.

text: Kun qulqullina agartuu kan negatiivii 35mm caalaa harka afur kan ta’u kenna (3136mm2 gara 864 tti wal caala).
eng_text: This gives resolution almost four times that of a 35 mm negative (3136 mm2 versus 864).

text: Lubbu-qabeeyyiin bosonaa fakkeenyawwan suuraa kaastotatti qormaata hundaan olii ta’anidha, akkasumas milkii, obsa, muuxannoo fi meeshaa gaarii kan barbaadanidha.
eng_text: Wildlife is among the most challenging motifs for a photographer, and needs a combination of good luck, patience, experience and good equipment.

text: Suuraan jireenya bosonaa haala namati toluun kaafamu, garuu akka suuraati walumagalati, suuraan jechoota kumaatama caala haasa’a.
eng_text: Wildlife photography is often taken for granted, but like photography in general, a picture is worth a thousand words.

text: Suura bineensota daggalaa kaasun kaameeraa leensii dheeraa qabu gaafata, wantootni akka gurmuu simbiraa ykn uumama xixxiqqaa ta’an leensi adda biraa barbaadu.
eng_text: Wildlife photography often requires a long telephoto lens, though things like a flock of birds or a tiny creature need other lenses.

text: Bineensota adda ta’an arguun kan rakkisuu fi paarkiiwwan immoo yeroo tokko tokko dhimmoota daldalaatiif suuraa kaasuu ilaalchisee seerota qabu.
eng_text: Many exotic animals are hard to find, and parks sometimes have rules about taking photographs for commercial purposes.

text: Bineensotni daggalaa qaana’oo ykn hamoo ta’u. Bakkichii qorraa, ho’aa, ykn jiraachuuf dadhabsiisaa ta’uu mala.
eng_text: Wild animals might either be shy or aggressive. The environment might be cold, hot, or otherwise hostile.

text: Addunyaan afaanota garaa garaa 5,000 ol qabdi, digdamaa ol kan dubbattoota miiliyoona 50 yookaan isaa olii kan qaban dabalatee.
eng_text: The world has over 5,000 different languages, including more than twenty with 50 million or more speakers.

text: Akkasumas, jechoonni barrefaman yeroo heduu kan dubbataman calaa huubachuuf salphaadha. Kun keessattuu teessoowwan, kanneen haala hundi hubatuun sagaleessuuf yeroo hedduu namatti ulfaataniif dhugaadha.
eng_text: Written words are often easier to understand than spoken words, also. This is especially true of addresses, which are often difficult to pronounce intelligibly.

text: Biyyoonni addunyaa baayyeen afaan ingiliiziii sirriitti dubbatu, baayyee beekumsa murtawaa illee isaanirraa eeguu dandeessa namoota ga’eessa irraa iyyuu.
eng_text: Many entire nations are completely fluent in English, and in even more you can expect a limited knowledge - especially among younger people.

text: Yaadi, yoo si’I, Mankuwaniyan, Bostoniyaan, Jamaayikaawi fi Sidinsayider minjaala tokko irra naannoftaanii irbaata wajjin mana nyaata Torontoo keessatti qabatan.
eng_text: Imagine, if you will, a Mancunian, Bostonian, Jamaican and Sydneysider sitting around a table having dinner at a restaurant in Toronto.

text: Oduuwwan bakkee dhaloota isaanii loqoda naannoo isaaniitii fi dubbii gareewwan muraasaatiin walitti himuudhaan wal bashannansiisaa jiru.
eng_text: They're regaling each other with stories from their hometowns, told in their distinct accents and local argot.

text: Nyaata supermaarkeetii keessaa bituun karaa of nyaachisuu isa saphaati. Osoo carraa bilcheessu hin qabaatin garuu, filannon nyaata qophaa’anii ga’aan qofaatti daanga’a.
eng_text: Buying food in supermarkets is usually the cheapest way to get fed. Without cooking opportunities, choices are however limited to ready-made food.

text: Suuppermaarkeetiiwwan kutaa nyaata qophaa’aa caalmaatti adda adda ta’e argataa jiraachuun isaanii daddabalaa dhufeera. Gariin isaanii immoo maayikirooweevii yookaan mala ittiin nyaata ho’isan biraa dhiyeessu.
eng_text: Increasingly supermarkets are getting a more varied section of ready-made food. Some even provide a microwave oven or other means to heat food.

text: Biyyoota muraasa keessatti yookiin gosoota kuusaa tokko tokko keessatti yoo xiqqaate mana nyaata tokkotu bakka hojiirra jira, baay’inaan kan seera hincimsineefi gatiin isaanii madaalawaa kan ta’e.
eng_text: In some countries or types of stores there is at least one on-site restaurant, often a rather informal one with affordable prices.

text: Imaammata kee fi teessoo qaama inshuraansii si seensisee koppii godhadhuutii qabadhuu deemi.
eng_text: Make and carry copies of your policy and your insurer's contact details with you.

text: Gorsaaf/seera-qabeessa taasisuudhaafi wanta isaaniif malu gaafachuudhaaf teessoo ii-meeyilii fi lakkoofsa bilbilaa idil-addunyaa isa inshuraansii namaaf galee agarsiisuu qabu.
eng_text: They need to show the insurer's e-mail address and international phone numbers for advice/authorizations and making claims.

text: Garagalcha kan biraa korojoo kee keessatti akka qabattuu fi toora interneetaarraan(Iimeelii qabsiisaa wajjiin ofiif godhi,yookiin “kilawodi” irra olkaayi).
eng_text: Have another copy in your luggage and online (e-mail to yourself with attachment, or stored in the "cloud").

text: Laaptooppii yookaan taabileetii fudhattee imalaa jirta yoo ta’e, garagalcha meemorii yookaan diiskii isaa (intarneetii malee itti fayyadamuun danda’amu) keessa kaawwadhu.
eng_text: If traveling with a laptop or tablet, store a copy in its memory or disc (accessible without the internet).

text: Akkasumas, koppii imaammataa/namoota quunnamamanii namoota waliin imalanii fi firoottanii ykn hiriyoottan biyyaa isaan gargaaruudhaaf fedha qabaniif kenni.
eng_text: Also give policy/contact copies to traveling companions and relatives or friends back home willing to help.

text: Muusonni (akkasumas gadamsaankan bekaman) dhaalaan gameyyii miti, garuu yoo hammeenya itti dhufuuf jedhu hubatan of irraa ni ittisu.
eng_text: Moose (also known as elk) aren't inherently aggressive, but will defend themselves if they perceive a threat.

text: Yeroo namoonni hantuuta akka balaa fiduttii hin laalle, baay’ee itti siqanii of balaa keessa galchu.
eng_text: When people don't see moose as potentially dangerous, they may approach too closely and put themselves at risk.

text: Dhugaatii alkoolii giddugaleessummaan dhugi. Alkooliin nama hundumaa garaagara huba, akkasumallee daangaakee bekuun bayyee barbaachisaadha.
eng_text: Drink alcoholic drinks with moderation. Alcohol affects everyone differently, and knowing your limit is very important.

text: Dhugaatii hammaan olii irraa dhukkuboonni ka’u danda’an miidhamuu tiruu fi keessumayyu agartu dhabuufi du’a dabalata. Sodaan inni guddaan kan dabalu yeroo dhugaatii seeran ala oomishaman fayyadamnu dha.
eng_text: Possible long term health events from excessive drinking can include liver damage and even blindness and death. The potential danger is increased when consuming illegally produced alcohol.

text: Dhugaatin seeran alaa wantoota baayee cimoo ta’aan kan akka miitanoolii, kan ija jaamsuu ykn yooma xiqqoo fudhatanilee du’a qaqqabsiisuu danda’u qaba.
eng_text: Illegal spirits can contain various dangerous impurities including methanol, which can cause blindness or death even in small doses.

text: Biyya alaatti fuulleewwan-ijaa rakasa ta’uu danda’u, keessumaa biyoota gatii numna nama gatii- gadi-bu’aa ta’e qaban keessatti.
eng_text: Eyeglasses can be cheaper in a foreign country, especially in low-income countries where labour costs are lower.

text: Manatti akka waan qorannoo ija argaatuti yaadii, keessumatuu yoo inshuuransiin danda’eef, akkasumas kan itti ajaajamee faayilaa biraa waliin fideef.
eng_text: Consider getting an eye exam at home, especially if insurance covers it, and bringing the prescription along to be filed elsewhere.

text: Fireemiiwwan maqaa biraandii fi mi’aawoon naannoo kanatti argaman rakkoolee lama qabaachuu danda’u ; tokko waraabbii ta’uu danda’a, kanneen dhugaamatti alaa galfaman immoo isa biyya keessaa caalaa qaalii ta’uu malu.
eng_text: High-end brand-name frames available in such areas may have two problems; some may be knock-offs, and the real imported ones may be more expensive than at home.

text: Bunni akka aduunyaati oomisha adeemu dha, fi isin naannoo biyyaa keessaniti gosoota adda addaa argachuu dandeessu.
eng_text: Coffee is one of the world's most traded commodities, and you can probably find many types in your home region.

text: Haa ta’u malee, karaawwan buna itti dhugan adda ta’an hedduutu addunyaa kanarra jiru, kanneen baramuu qaban.
eng_text: Nevertheless, there are many distinctive ways of drinking coffee around the world that are worth experiencing.

text: Kaaniyooniingi (yookaan: kaaniyooniiriingiin) waa’ee sulula keessa deemuuti, kan gogaa yookaan bishaaniin guutuu ta’e.
eng_text: Canyoning (or: canyoneering) is about going in a bottom of a canyon, which is either dry or full of water.

text: Utaalchi bishaan humnaan gaararraa gad bu’u keessatti godhamu bishaan daakuu, tabba ba’uu fi utaaluu walitti qabataa--garuu jalqabuuf yaalii sochii qaamaa xiqqaa ykn haala dhaabbata qaamaa xiqqoo barbaada (fakkeenyaaf, yeroo dhagaa koruu, qilleensa meeshaa keessatti kuufame qabatanii bishaan daakuu, ykn gaara irraa cabbiirra gadi mucucaachuu).
eng_text: Canyoning combines elements from swimming, climbing and jumping--but requires relatively little training or physical shape to get started (compared to rock climbing, scuba diving or alpine skiing, for example).

text: Haayikingiin gochaa mana alati kan naannoowwan Uumamaa keessa adeemu dabalatu, yeroo hedduu yaali haayikiingi keessatti.
eng_text: Hiking is an outdoor activity which consists of walking in natural environments, often on hiking trails.

text: Guyyaan tabba yaabun maayila walakka gadii kaasee hamma fageenya dheeratti guyyya tokko keessatti waliin gahuu hirmaachisa.
eng_text: Day hiking involves distances of less than a mile up to longer distances that can be covered in a single day.

text: Yaalii utaalcha cabbii irraa guyyaadhaf qophiin muraasni barbaachisaa dha, fi namni ga’aan kamiyuu itti bashanaanu danda’a.
eng_text: For a day hike along an easy trail little preparations are needed, and any moderately fit person can enjoy them.

text: Maatiiwwan ijoollee xixiqqoo qaban qophii dabalataa barbaaduu danda’u, garuu guyyaa bakkeetti dabarsuun salphaadhumatti mucoolii fi ijoollota oolmaa daa’immanii jiran waliiniyyuu ni danda’ama.
eng_text: Families with small children may need more preparations, but a day outdoors is easily possible even with babies and pre-school children.

text: Akka addunyaatti, dhaabbata daawwachiisaa 200 dhi’atantu jiru. Hedduun isaanii of danda’anii socho’u.
eng_text: Internationally, there are nearly 200 running tour organizations. Most of them operate independently.

text: Dhaalaan Giloobal Raaningi Tuursi, Goo Raaningi Tuursiin neetworkii darzaanan kan fuulen figaan kan ardii afur keessatti deemu.
eng_text: The Global Running Tours successor, Go Running Tours networks dozens of sightrunning providers on four continents.

text: Imalaa fiigu Barseelona fi kan fiigicha kan Kopenhagen fiigicha Kopenhagen, ariitiidhaan imaaltoota fiiganiin makame kan pargiwuu keessatti argamu.
eng_text: With roots in Barcelona's Running Tours Barcelona and Copenhagen's Running Copenhagen, it was quickly joined by Running Tours Prague based in Prague and others.

text: Yeroo bakkaa bakkatti imaaluuf yaaddan duraafi yeroo imalaa wantoota ilaalcha keessa galchuu qabdan hedduutu jiru.
eng_text: There are many things you have to take into consideration before and when you travel somewhere.

text: Gaafa imaltu, wantootni akka “manaa” akka ta’aniiti hin eegin. Amaloota, seerota, nyaata, konkolaataa, bakkee buufataa, sadarkaawwan, afaanii fi kkf bakka ati jirtu irraa ni jijjiiramu.
eng_text: When you travel, expect things not to be like they are "back home". Manners, laws, food, traffic, lodging, standards, language and so on will to some extent differ from where you live.

text: Mufii yookaan tarii akkaataa namootni naannootti wantoota itti hojjetan jibbuuma iyyuu hambisuuf kun waan ati yeroo mara sammuutti qabachuu qabdudha.
eng_text: This is something you always need to keep in mind, to avoid disappointment or perhaps even distaste over local ways to do things.

text: Ejansoonnii imalaa jaarraa 19ffaa egalee maddii turan. Ejensiin imalaa, yeroo baay’ee imala bal’aa kan imalaan muuxannoo umamaa, aadaa, afaan yookiin biyyoota galii xiqqoo irratti kan kanaan dura godhe caalu gochuuf filannoo gaarii dha.
eng_text: Travel agencies have been around since the 19th century. A travel agent is usually a good option for a journey which extends beyond a traveller's previous experience of nature, culture, language or low-income countries.

text: Yoodhuma Ejansootni baayeen galmee bakka qabachuu idilee fudhachuuf barbaadaniyyuu, ejantootni hedduun kan isaan baayee irratti hirmaatan imalaa bifa addaa ta’e, akkasumaas hamma baajataa yookiin bakka ga’umsaa irratti.
eng_text: Although most agencies are willing to take on most regular bookings, many agents specialise in particular types of travel, budget ranges or destinations.

eng_text: If you want to see the world on the cheap, for necessity, lifestyle or challenge, there are some ways to do that.

eng_text: Basically, they fall into two categories: Either work while you travel or try and limit your expenses. This article is focused on the latter.

eng_text: For those willing to sacrifice comfort, time and predictability to push expenses down close to zero, see minimum budget travel.

eng_text: The advice assumes that travellers do not steal, trespass, participate in the illegal market, beg, or otherwise exploit other people for their own gain.

eng_text: Registration is an additional requirement for the visa process. In some countries, you must register your presence and address where you are staying with the local authorities.

eng_text: If traveling in a developing country for the first time – or in a new part of the world – don't underestimate the potential culture shock.

eng_text: Especially in your initial days, consider splurging on Western-style and -quality hotels, food, and services to help acclimatize.

eng_text: Do not sleep on a mattress or pad on the ground in areas where you do not know the local fauna.

eng_text: If you're feeling more adventurous, take the opportunity to juice or blend up some smoothies:

eng_text: For those unfamiliar with medical jargon, the words infectious and contagious have distinct meanings.

eng_text: An infectious disease is one that is caused by a pathogen, such as a virus, bacterium, fungus or other parasites.

eng_text: Many governments require visitors entering, or residents leaving, their countries to be vaccinated for a range of diseases.

eng_text: One of strong points of Charlotte, North Carolina, is that it has an abundance of high-quality options for families.

eng_text: The South Pole Traverse (or Highway) is a 1600 km trail from McMurdo Station on the Ross Sea to the Pole.

eng_text: The most common cause for accidents in winter is slippery roads, pavements (sidewalks) and especially steps.

eng_text: At a minimum, you need footwear with suitable soles. Summer shoes are usually very slippery on ice and snow, even some winter boots are deficient.

eng_text: The pattern should be deep enough, 5 mm (1/5 inch) or more, and the material soft enough in cold temperatures.

eng_text: Some boots have studs and there is studded add-on equipment for slippery conditions, suitable for most shoes and boots, for the heels or heels and sole.

eng_text: Heels should be low and wide. Sand, gravel or salt (calcium chloride) is often scattered on roads or paths to improve traction.

text: Cabbiin kan hin baratamnee miti; hallayyaan suutaan qofa qabuu danda’a, akkasumas hammi guddaan akka cabbiitti gadi dhufuu danda’a.
eng_text: Avalanches are not an abnormality; steep slopes can hold only so much slow, and the excess volumes will come down as avalanches.

text: Rakkoon isaa sababa cabbiin walqabatee walharkisuufi, kanaafuu gad dhufuuf tuttuqaa wayii barbaada, cabbiin muraasni gadi dhufu ammoo kan haafeef ceesistuu ta’uu danda’a.
eng_text: The problem is that snow is sticky, so it needs some triggering to come down, and some snow coming down can be the triggering event for the rest.

eng_text: Sometimes the original trigging event is the sun warming the snow, sometimes some more snowfall, sometimes other natural events, often a human.

text: Toorneedoon utubaa qilleensa naanna’uu kan qilleensa dhiibbaan isaa baay’ee gad aanaa ta’ee, kan qilleensa naannoo of keessattii fi gara oliitti harkisu.
eng_text: A tornado is a spinning column of very low-pressure air, which sucks the surrounding air inward and upward.

text: Bubbee guddaa gad dhiisu (yeroo hedduu sa’atiitti maayelii 100-200), fi yeroo toorneedochi socho’uu of duukaa baachaa, meeshaalee ulfaatoo qilleensa keessatti achii ol kaasuu danda’a.
eng_text: They generate high winds (often 100-200 miles/hour) and can lift heavy objects into the air, carrying them as the tornado moves.

eng_text: They begin as funnels descending from storm clouds, and become "tornadoes" when they touch the ground.

text: Dhiyeessitoonni VPN dhuunfaa (neetwoorkii dhuunfaa abjata) karaa hunda caalaa saansuurummaa siyaasaa fi fi dinagdee ip-geofilteringii ittiin barbaadanidha.
eng_text: Personal VPN (virtual private network) providers are an excellent way of circumventing both political censorship and commercial IP-geofiltering.

text: Sababoota hedduu pirooksiiwwan weebiihunda caalanidha: Irraa deebiin root godhanii Tiraafiika inteerneta, http qofa miti.
eng_text: They are superior to web proxies for several reasons: They re-route all Internet traffic, not only http.

text: Yeroo hedduu baandiwiidzii olaanaa fi tajaajila qulqullina fooyya’aa qabu kennu. Iccitiidhaan waan barreeffamaniif basaasuudhaaf rakkisoodha.
eng_text: They normally offer higher bandwidth and better quality of service. They are encrypted and thus harder to spy on.

text: Kaampaaniileen miidiyaa yeroodhuma yeroon waa’ee kaayyoo kanaa, “wanbadee galaanaa dhorkuufidha” jechanii sobuun falmu.
eng_text: The media companies routinely lie about the purpose of this, claiming that it is to "prevent piracy".

text: Dhugaaman, koodiin naannoo galagalcha seeraan alaa keessatti qooda hin qabu; sutaa-suutan- diiskiitti galagalchuun meeshaa kamuu kan inni jalqabaa taphatu irratti akka sirriiti taphatu gochuu danda’a.
eng_text: In fact, region codes have absolutely no effect on illegal copying; a bit-for-bit copy of a disk will play just fine on any device where the original will.

text: Dhimmi inni guddaan Kaampanoota kana akka isaan gabaa isaanii to’atan gochuu dha; wantichi mallaquma naanneessuudha.
eng_text: The actual purpose is to give those companies more control over their markets; it's all about money spinning.

text: Intarneetirratti bilbila bilbiluun waan danda’amuuf, bakka jiraattuu fi deemte hundatti kaampaanii bilbilaa fayyadamuun dirqama tawuu dhiisuu danda’a.
eng_text: Because calls are routed over the Internet, you do not need to use a phone company located where you live or where you travel.

text: Hawaasa keessa jiraattu irraa lakkoofsa gandaa fudhachuun illee sirraa hin eegamu; daggala Chiken, Alaaskaa keessatti quunnamtii intarneetaa saatelaayitii fudhattee lakkoofsa aduu Aarizoonaa keessa jiraachuu kee dubbatu filachuu dandeessa.
eng_text: There is also no requirement that you obtain a local number from the community in which you live; you can obtain a satellite Internet connection in the wilds of Chicken, Alaska and select a number which claims you're in sunny Arizona.

text: Yeroo hedduu, lakkoofsa addunyaawaa, kan bilbiloota Neetoorkii Bilbilaa Uummataan Banamee-Cufamu akka isaan sii bilbilan isaan dandeessisu, addatti bitachuu qabda. Namoota sii bilbilaniif maddi bilbilichaa garaagarummaa fida.
eng_text: Often, you have to buy a global number separately that allows PSTN phones to call you. Where the number is from makes a difference for people calling you.

text: Appilikeeshinoota barreeffama hiikan kan yeroo-dhugaa-applikeeshinoota battalumatti guutummaa kutaalee barreeffamaa afaan tokkorraa kan biraatti hiikuuf danda’aniidha.
eng_text: Real-time text translator apps – applications that are capable of automatically translating whole segments of text from one language into another.

text: Appilikeeshinootni garee kanaa baay’een barreeffamoota afaanota biyya alaa kan mallatoodhaan ykn wantoota birooaddunyaa dhugaa keessa jiran hiikuu danda’u, yeroo fayyadamaan bilbila ammayyaa gara meeshaalee sanaatti qabu.
eng_text: Some of the applications in this category can even translate texts in foreign languages on signs or other objects in the real world when the user points the smartphone towards those objects.

text: Meeshotni afaan hiikaan haala aja’ibsiisan jijjirama fiidaniiru, fi amma hiikaa hedduu yookiin muraasa sirrii kennuu (fi kan wal hin fakkane muraasa), garuu ammayu sirritti ilaalamu qabu, ammayuu sababa dogogora jiraachu danda’aniif.
eng_text: The translation engines have improved dramatically, and now often give more or less correct translations (and more seldom gibberish), but some care is due, as they still may have gotten it all wrong.

text: Fayyadamsisaa beekamoo gosa kanaa keessa tokko Google Translate dha, erga daataa afaan barbaadamuu buufatanii booda interneeta malee hiika argachuu dandeessisa.
eng_text: One of the most prominent apps in this category is Google Translate, which allows offline translation after downloading the desired language data.

text: Mosaajjiiwwan deemsa GPS bilbila ismaartii kee irratti fayadamuun karaa isa baay’ee salphaa fi mijaataa dha.
eng_text: Using GPS navigation apps on your smartphone can be the easiest and most convenient way to navigate when out of your home country.

text: Qarshii qusachuu danda’a kaartaa haaraa bituu irra GPS’f, yookiin GPS qofaa dhabatu yookiin makiina tokko bakka makiina kireesani fudhachu.
eng_text: It can save money over buying new maps for a GPS, or a standalone GPS device or renting one from a car rental company.

text: Yoo bilbili kee deetaa qunnamsiisu hin qabu tahe yookin yoo sararaan ala ta’e. Hujjeeffami isaa murtaa’aadha yookin hin hojjetu.
eng_text: If you don't have a data connection for your phone, or when it is out of range, their performance can be limited or unavailable.

text: Tokkoon tokkoon mana kuusaa moggaa irraa kaardiiwwan bilbilaa kaffaltii duraa namaa galuu waliin nama dhahan, kanneen bilbiloota itti kaffalaman yookaan bilbiloota beekamoo irraa fayyadamuun danda’amuun guutanii jiru.
eng_text: Every corner store is filled with a confusing array of pre-paid phone cards that can be used from pay phones or ordinary telephones.

text: Yeroo kaardiiwwan hedduun iddoo hunda bilbiluuf gaarii ta’anitti tokko tokko garee biyyoota murtaa’aniitiif dhiheessa bilbila addaa qaba.
eng_text: While most cards are good for calling anywhere, some specialise in providing favourable call rates to specific groups of countries.

text: Tajaajiloota kanniin argachuun kan danda’amu yeroo hedduu karaa lakkoofsa bilbilaa gatii bilisaa isa bilbila harka caalaa isaa irraa gatii malee bilbilamuuti.
eng_text: Access to these services is often through a toll-free telephone number that can be called from most phones without charge.

text: Seerri gama suuraa idileetin jiru waraabbii viidiyoo irrattis hojii irra ni oola, danda’amnaan isaan olitti illee.
eng_text: Rules regarding regular photography also apply to video recording, possibly even more so.

text: Yoo suraa wanta tokkoo kaasuun hin hayamamne, itti aansee vidiyoo waraabuuf gonkumaa yaaduu hin qabdu.
eng_text: If just taking a photo of something isn't allowed, then you shouldn't even think of recording a video of it.

text: Yoo diroonii fayyadamta ta’e, dursii maal akka waraabuuf siif heyyemamu, eenyu akka heyyamu yookaan heyyamni dabalataa akka barbaachisu mirkaneeffadhu.
eng_text: If using a drone, check well in advance as to what you are allowed to film and what permits or additional licensing are required.

text: Diroonii naannoo buufata xiyyaaraa bira fi bakkee namni itti baay’attu irra balaliisuun yaada badaa dha, yooma naannoo keessaniitti seeraan ala ta’uu baatellee.
eng_text: Flying a drone near an airport or over a crowd is almost always a bad idea, even if it's not illegal in your area.

text: Yeroo ammaa kana osoo jalqaba barbaadanii gatii isaanii hin madaalchisfne kallattidhaan buufata xiyyaaraatii bitachuun imala qilleensa keessatti baay’ee xiqqaadha.
eng_text: Nowadays air travel is only rarely booked directly through the airline without first searching and comparing prices.

text: Yeroo tokko tokko balaliin walfakkaataan iddoo garaagaraatti gatiin isaa adda ta’uu danda’a fi bu’aa barbaachaa irratti hundaa’a akkasumas bituun duratti marsareetti buufata qilleensichaa ilaaluudha.
eng_text: Sometimes the same flight can have vastly differing prices at various agregators and it pays to compare search results and to also look at the website of the airline itself before booking.

text: Daawwwanaa yeroo muraasa yookan hojiidhaaf biyya biraa deemte tarii viisaa si barbaachisuu dhiisuu ni danda’a. Akka daawwataa tokkootti deemu irra akka barataa addunyaalessaatti deemuun walumaa galatti turtii dheeraa barbaada.
eng_text: While you may not need a visa for short visits to certain countries as a tourist or for business, going there as an international student generally requires a longer stay than going there just as a casual tourist.

text: Walumaagalatti, biyya alaa kam keessa iyyuu yeroo dheeraaf turuuf dursitee viizaa argachuu si barbaachisa.
eng_text: In general, staying in any foreign country for an extended period of time will require you to obtain a visa in advance.

text: Viizaan barattootaa viizaa tuuristii ykn viisaa daldalaa irraa ulaagaalee barbaachisanii fi adeemsa iyyannaa adda ta’ee qaba.
eng_text: Student visas generally have different requirements and application procedures from normal tourist or business visas.

text: Biyyoota harka caalaniif, dhaabbata itti barachuu barbaadde irraa xalayaa afeerraa kan si barbaachisuu fi kana malees ragaa deeggarsa maallaqaa kan yoo xiqqaateef wagga jalqabaa koorsii keetiitiif ittiin of deeggartu si barbaachisa.
eng_text: For most countries, you will need an offer letter from the institution you wish to study at, and also evidence of funds to support yourself for at least the first year of your course.

text: Dhaabbaticharraa adda baafadhu, akkasumas ulaagaalee gadi-fagoodhaaf kutaa immigireeshinii biyya keessatti barachuu barbbaadduu gaafadhu.
eng_text: Check with the institution, as well as the immigration department for the country you wish to study in for detailed requirements.

text: Yoo dippiloomaati taate malee, biiyya alaa keessaa dalaguu jechuun akka waliigalaatti biyya bu’ureeffatte keessatti gibira galii kee galchuu qabda.
eng_text: Unless you are a diplomat, working overseas generally means that you will have to file income tax in the country you are based in.

text: Qaraxni galii biyyoota garaa garaatti caasaa garaa garaa qaba, akkasumas haammi qaraxaa fi sadallaas biyya biyyaatti baayee garaa garadha.
eng_text: Income tax is structured differently in different countries, and the tax rates and brackets vary widely from one country to another.

text: Biyyoota federaalaawoo tokko tokko, kan akka Ameerikaa fi Kaanaadaa keessa, gibirri galii sadarkaalee federaalaatii fi naannootti sassaabama, kanaafuu hammii fi sadaallii naannoo naannootti garaa gara ta’uu danda’u.
eng_text: In some federal countries, such as the United States and Canada, income tax is levied both at the federal level and at the local level, so the rates and brackets can vary from region to region.

text: Yemmuu biyya kee geessu, to’annaan seensaa yeroo hedduu kan hinjirre yookaan kan seerumaaf raawwatamu yemmuu ta’u, to’annaan gumrukii garuu girdirsaa ta’uu danda’a.
eng_text: While immigration check is usually absent or a formality when you arrive in your homeland, customs control can be a hassle.

text: Waan as fiduu dandeessuu fi hin dandeenye akka beektu mirkaneessi, waan hundumaa daangaa seeraa irratti ibsa godhi.
eng_text: Make sure you know what you can and cannot bring in and declare anything over the legal limits.

text: Karaan salphaan imala daldalaa barreessuu ittiin jalqaban, biloogii marsariitii imala beekamaa irratti dandeettii kee mullisuudhaani.
eng_text: The easiest way to get started in the business of travel writing is to hone your skills on an established travel blog website.

text: Erga ati sirreessuu fi bocuu weebii irraatti sirriiti itti quufteebooda, itti aansuudhaan, marsariitii mataa keetii banachuu dandeessa.
eng_text: After you become comfortable with formatting and editing on the web, then later, you might create your own website.

text: Osoo imalarra jiranii tola ooluun garaagarummaa fiduudhaaf karaa bareedaadha, garuu wantichi waa’eema kennuu qofaa miti.
eng_text: Volunteering while travelling is a great way to make a difference but it's not just about giving.

text: Biyya ormaa keessatti jirachuufi tajaajila tola oltuummana gochuun aadaa adda biraan wal baruuf, namoota haaraa baruuf, waa’ee mataa kee baruuf, ilaalcha haaraa argaachuuf akkasumas oguumma haaraa dabalachuufillee karaa gaarii dha.
eng_text: Living and volunteering in a foreign country is a great way to get to know a different culture, meet new people, learn about yourself, get a sense of perspective and even gain new skills.

text: Hojiiwwan tolaa kutaalee muraasa fi manaa fi nyaata akkasumas kafaltii xiqqoo waan dhiheessuuf yeroo dheeraaf bakka ta’e akka turuuf baajata osoo dheeratee.
eng_text: It can also be a good way to stretch a budget to allow a longer stay somewhere since many volunteer jobs provide room and board and a few pay a small salary.

text: Vaayikingootni karaa bishaanii warraa Raashiyaa fayyadamuun Galaana Gurrachaaf Galaana Kapsiin’tti darbuu. Qaamotni Karaalee kanaa muraasni amallee fayyadamuun ni danda’ama. Barbaachisummaa eyyama tuqaa sakatta’iinsa addaa gaafadhu , kan argaachuf baayee ulfaata ta’uu mala.
eng_text: Vikings used the Russian waterways to get to the Black Sea and Caspian Sea. Parts of these routes can still be used. Check possible need for special permits, which may be difficult to get.

text: Sululli Hara-Baaltik Galaana Arkitik Hara Baaltik, Haroo Laadoogaa fi Seenti Peeterisbergi wajjiin caalaatti lagaa fi haroo walitti hidha.
eng_text: The White Sea–Baltic Canal connects the Arctic Ocean to the Baltic Sea, via Lake Onega, Lake Ladoga and Saint Petersburg, mostly by rivers and lakes.

text: Haroon Ooneegaa Voolgaa waliin wal qabatee jira, kanaafu galaana Kaspiyaan irraa karaa Raashiyaa dhufuun ammayyu ni danda’ama.
eng_text: Lake Onega is also connected to Volga, so coming from the Caspian Sea through Russia is still possible.

text: Akka ati buufata bidiruuwwanii qarqara galaanaa geesseen wanti hundumtuu ifa akka ta’u siifan mirkaneessa. Namoota bidiruudhaan bashannanan biroo kan argituu fi isaanis odeeffannoo isaanii siif ni qoodu
eng_text: Be assured that once you hit the marinas everything will be pretty obvious. You will meet other boat hitchhikers and they will share their information with you.

text: Bu’uuraanuu beeksiisa gargaarsa kee barbaaduu ni keessa, deemsa hidhii, namoota doonii dorgommii isaanii qulqulleessan duukaa bu’uu, namoota doonii to’atan waliin mana dhugaatii keessatti walquunnamuu fi kan kana fakkaatan.
eng_text: Basically you'll be putting up notices offering your help, pacing the docks, approaching people cleaning their yachts, trying to make contact with sailors in the bar, etc.

text: Namoota hedduu hanga dandeessetti dubbachuuf yaali. Yeroo muraasa booda hunduu si baree bidiruun inni kam eenyuun akka eegaa jiru odeeffannoo hanga tokko sii kenna.
eng_text: Try to talk to as many people as possible. After a while everyone will know you and will give you hints as to which boat is looking for someone.

text: Ati sirriiiti eeggannodhaan dhaabbataa balalii yeroo baay’ee fayyadamtu filachuu qabda.
eng_text: You should choose your Frequent Flyer airline in an alliance carefully.

text: Akkasuma akka ati yaaduutti dandeetti buufata xiiyaraa yeroo baayee fayyadamtuutti makaamuf fedhuu yoo maltellee, carraawwan argaamu danda’aan garaagara waan ta’aniif buufata xiyaara adda addaa waliin balali’uun arjooma caalaa argachuudandeessa.
eng_text: Although you may think it is intuitive to join the airline you fly most, you should be aware that privileges offered are often different and frequent flyer points may be more generous under a different airline in the same alliance.

text: Buufataleen xiyyaara kan akka Eemireetsi, Karaa Qilleensaa Itahaad, Karaa Qilleensaa Kuwaatar fi Karaa qilleensaa Turkii tajaajila isaaanii gara Afrikaatti guddaa kan babal’isanii fi karaa qilleensaa Awurooppaanotaa caalaa magaalota aafriikaatti haala waldorgommiin tajaajila walquunnamtii kennaniiru.
eng_text: Airlines such as Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways & Turkish Airlines have greatly expanded their services to Africa, and offer connections to many major African cities at competitive rates than other European airlines.

text: Sararri xiyyaara Turkii biyyoota Afirikaa 30 keessatti bakkoota ga’umsaa 39 itti balali’a, akka bara 2014tti.
eng_text: Turkish Airlines flies to 39 destinations in 30 African countries as of 2014.

text: Yoo sa’aatii imalaa dabalataa qabda ta’e, ilaali gatiin Afrikaa deemuf waliigalati si kenname kan addunyaaf si kenname waliin wal bukkee qabamu.
eng_text: If you have additional travel time, check to see how your total fare quote to Africa compares with a round-the-world fare.

text: Kaffaltii dabalataa viizaaf dabaluu hin dagatinaa, qaraxa biyya-dhiisanii deemuu, geejjiiba lafaa fi kan kana fakkaatan. Bakkeewwan hundaa Afrikaa ala ta'aan sanaaf.
eng_text: Don't forget to add in the extra costs of additional visas, departure taxes, ground transportation, etc. for all those places outside of Africa.

text: Yoo addunyaa guutummaatti naanna’uu barbaadda ta’e naannoo heemisfeera Kibbaa, filannoo balalii fi bakki ga’umsaa murtaa’aadha sababa daandii qaxxaamura garbaa waliin qabaniini.
eng_text: If you want to fly around the world completely in the Southern Hemisphere, the choice of flights and destinations is limited due to the lack of transoceanic routes.

text: Walta’iinsi daandii xiyyaaraa kam iyyuu qaxxaamura galaanaa Heemisfiirii Kibbaa keessatti argaman sadanuu waliinga’u hinjiru (fi IskaayTiim immoo qaxxaamurawwan kanniin keessaa tokko illee waliin hinga’u).
eng_text: No airline alliance covers all three ocean crossings in the Southern Hemisphere (and SkyTeam covers none of the crossings).

text: Haa ta’uu iyuu malee, Istaar Aaliyaansiin baha Paasifikii Kibbaa, Saantiyaagoo de Chiilii irraa hanga Tahiitii, isa kan balali’a Waanwoorlidi LATAM ta’e irraa kan hafe waan hunda waliin ga’a.
eng_text: However, Star Alliance covers everything except the eastern South Pacific from Santiago de Chile to Tahiti, which is a LATAM Oneworld flight.

text: Balalliin kun filannoo isa qofaamiti yoo Kibba Paasifiikii fi qarqara galaanaa gara dhihaa Ameerikaa Kibbaarra utaaluu yoo barbaadde. (kan gadii ilaali)
eng_text: This flight is not the only option if you want to skip the South Pacific and the west coast of South America. (see below)

text: 1994 tti, gosti Armeeniyaanotaa naannoo Nagorno-Karabaki kan naannoo Azerbajaan waraana Azeeris irratti bane.
eng_text: In 1994, the ethnically Armenian Nagorno-Karabakh region of Azerbaijan waged war against the Azeris.

text: Gargaarsa Armeeniyaatin riippaabilikii haraan uumamee ture. Haa ta’u malee - biyyi hundaa’e tokko illee - Armeeniyaamti illee beekamtii hin kennineef.
eng_text: With Armenian backing, a new republic was created. However, no established nation - not even Armenia - officially recognizes it.

text: Waldhabdeen dippiloomaatii Armeeniyaa fi Azerbaajiyaan naannoo irratti qaban gara hariiroo badiitti itti fufee jira.
eng_text: Diplomatic arguments over the region continue to mar relations between Armenia and Azerbaijan.

text: Aanaan Naannoo Dachii(Dachii: Giraachitengoordel) aanaa beekamaa jaarraa 17ffaa nannoo Biinenistaad kan Amisteerdaamiidha.
eng_text: The Canal District (Dutch: Grachtengordel) is the famous 17th-century district surrounding the Binnenstad of Amsterdam.

text: Aanaan hundinuu sababa aadaa adda ta’ee fi faayidaa seenaa fi hangi qabeenyumma isaas akka biyyaatti guddaa waan ta’eef, akka Iddoo Hambaa Seenaa Addunyaa UNESCO tii bocame.
eng_text: The whole district is designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site for its unique cultural and historical value, and its property values are among the highest of the country.

text: Chiinkuwee Teeree, kan hiiki isaa Lafawwan Shan jedhu, gandoota qarqara galaanaa xixiqqoo shan Riyoomaagiyooree, Maanaroollaa, Veernaazaa fi Moonterroosoo, warra kutaa biyyaa Xaaliyaanii, Liiguuriyaa keessatti argaman of keessatti hammata.
eng_text: Cinque Terre, which means Five Lands, comprises the five small coastal villages of Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza and Monterosso located in the Italian region of Liguria.

text: Isaan tarreeffamaniiru galme hambawwaan addunyaa UNESCO irratti.
eng_text: They are listed on the UNESCO World Heritage List.

text: Jaarraawan keessatti, namoonni eeggannoodhan bo'oowwan tabba, teessuma dhooqaa hamma fiixee qilee qarqara galaanaatti ijaaraniiru.
eng_text: Over the centuries, people have carefully built terraces on the rugged, steep landscape right up to the cliffs that overlook the sea.

text: Qaamni gaarummaasaa tokko dhibiinsa misooma dhaabbilee argamuu fudhachu danda’uudha. Karaaleen, baaburri fi bidiruuleen gandoota san wal-quunnamsiisan konkolaataawwan alarraan isaan bira ga’uu hin danda’an.
eng_text: Part of its charm is the lack of visible corporate development. Paths, trains and boats connect the villages, and cars cannot reach them from the outside.

text: Gosoonni afaan Faransaayi kan Beeljeemii fi Siwiizerlaandi keessatti dubatamanii, afaan Faransaayi kan Faransaayi keessatti dubatamurraa tiqqoo gargari, ta’us waan wal fakkaataniif walii galuudhaaf gahaa dha.
eng_text: The varieties of French which are spoken in Belgium and Switzerland differ slightly from the French spoken in France, though they are similar enough to be mutually intelligible.

text: Keessattuu, sirni lakkoofsaa biyyoota Afaan Faransaay dubbatan kan Beeljiyeemii fi Siwiizerlaandii Afaan Faransaay isa Faransaay keessatti dubbatamu irraa garagarummaa xiqqoo qaba, akkasumas sagaleessi jechoota muraasaas xiqqoo isii garaagara.
eng_text: In particular, the numbering system in French-speaking Belgium and Switzerland has some slight peculiarities that are different from the French spoken in France, and the pronunciation of some words is slightly different.

text: Ta’us, Swiizonnii fi Beeljiyeemonni afaan Faransaay dubbatan afaan faransaay isa sadarkaa isaa eeggate mana barnootaatti ni baratu, kanaaf ati sirna lakkofsaa Faransaay sadarkaa isaa eeggate fayyadamtus isaan si hubachuu danda’u.
eng_text: Nevertheless, all French-speaking Belgians and Swiss would have learned standard French in school, so they would be able to understand you even if you used the standard French numbering system.

text: Bakkoota addunyaa hedduu keessatti, fagooti harka walitti raasuun aggaammii hirriyummaa mul’isa, “nagumaa” jechuu agarsiisa.
eng_text: In many parts of the world, waving is a friendly gesture, indicating "hello."

text: Haa ta’u iyyuu malee, Maleezhiyaa keessatti, yoo xiqqaate jiraattota Maleezhiyaa kan baadiyaa jiraatan biratti, kana jechuun “as kottu,” isii jettu, kan quba agarsiistuu gara ofiitti dabsuudhaan, mallattoo biyyoottan dhihaa tokko tokko keessatti faayidaaf ooluu fi dhimma sana qofaaf ooluu kan qabudha.
eng_text: However, in Malaysia, at least among the Malays in rural areas, it means "come over," similar to the index finger bent toward the body, a gesture which is used in certain Western countries, and should be used only for that purpose.

text: Haala falfakkaatuun, Imaltuun Ingilizii ispeenii keessa yeroo nagaa barruu harkaa raasuun isa raasutti galagalee dhaamu dogoggoruu hin oolu (namichi haarkaan nagaan gaafatamee) akka akeeka deebiyanii dhufuutti.
eng_text: Similarly, a British traveller in Spain may mistake a wave goodbye involving the palm facing the waver (rather than the person being waved at) as a gesture to come back.

text: Afaanotni Ogzilaarii kan namaan hojjetamee yookiin ijaarame dha afaan wal qunnamtii ariifachiisuf kalaqamaan namoota giddutii yoo ta’uudha baate kan haasaan wal qunnamuuf rakkatan.
eng_text: Auxiliary languages are artificial or constructed languages created with the intent of facilitating communication between peoples who would otherwise have difficulty communicating.

text: Isaan linguwaa firaankaa, kanneen afaanota uumamaa ykn jalqabaa sababa tokkoof ykn kan biraaf akka mala waliin-dubbii dubbattoota afaanota biroo gidduutti caalaa iddoo fudhataa dhufaniidha.
eng_text: They are separate from lingua francas, which are natural or organic languages that become dominant for one reason or another as means of communication between speakers of other languages.

text: Yeroo guyyicha keessatti ho’inni ol ka’u, imaltootni abjuu guyyaa kan akka bishaan jiru itti fakkeesse mul’isu (yookiin wantoota biraa) isaan mudachuu danda’a.
eng_text: In the heat of the day, travelers can experience mirages that give the illusion of water (or other things).

text: Kun hamaa kan ta’u yoo imalaan humna gati jabeessaa fi bishaan hafe qisaasuudhaan calaqqee karaaa irraa hordofedha,.
eng_text: These can be dangerous if the traveler pursue the mirage, wasting precious energy and remaining water.

text: Gammojjiin hunda caala ho’u, halkran ammoo hunda caalaa ta’uu danda’a. Uffannaan ho’u hinjiru taanaan haayipooteermiyaan balaa nama mudachuu danada’udha.
eng_text: Even the hottest of deserts can become extremely cold at night. Hypothermia is a real risk without warm clothing.

text: Bona keessa, keessattuu, yoo bosona keessa miilla diriifachuuf murteessite bookee irraa of eeggachuu si barbaachisa.
eng_text: In summer, especially, you'll need to watch out for mosquitoes if you decide to hike through the rainforest.

text: Yooma nannoo bosona roobaa cita tirooppikii keessa konkolaachisaa jiraatte illee yeroo muraasni konkolaataa seenuuf jecha balbala konkolaataa banaatti dhiistu bookeewwan si faana konkolaataa keessa seenuuf gahaadha.
eng_text: Even if you're driving through the subtropical rainforest, a few seconds with the doors open while you get inside the vehicle is enough time for mosquitoes to get in the vehicle with you.

text: Beerd filuu, yookiin infuluweenza Aviyaan jedhamuun kan beekamu, sinbirrootaa fi hoosiftoota qabuu danda’a.
eng_text: Bird flu, or more formally avian influenza, can infect both birds and mammals.

text: Rakkoowwan kumaa gadi ta’an namoota irratti gabaasamanii jiru, garuu muraasni isaanii kan nama galaafatanidha.
eng_text: Fewer than a thousand cases have ever been reported in humans, but some of them have been fatal.

text: Baay'een isaanii namoota horsiisa lukkuu irratti hirmaachisaniiru garuu kan simbirroo eeganiif balaa tokko tokko qaba.
eng_text: Most have involved people who work with poultry, but there is also some risk to birdwatchers.

text: Noorweey kan ittiin beekamtu bishaan galaanaa qallatee gara dachaa baay’ee gad jedhaatti seenuu fi dachaawwan lafa ol jedhaa akka diriiraatti suuta adeemuuni.
eng_text: Typical for Norway are steep fjords and valleys that suddenly give way to a high, more or less even plateau.

text: Dirreen ol-kaoon kun yeroo heddu "vidde" jedhamu, akkas jechuun lafa bal’aa, iddoo bal’aa, banaa muka hin qabne, lafa daangaa hin qabneedha.
eng_text: These plateaus are often referred to as "vidde" meaning a wide, open treeless space, a boundless expanse.

text: Roogalaandii fi Agdeeritti yeroo bayyee isaan “hei” jedhamanii waamamu, hiiki isaas lafa muurlaandii muki irra hinjirre kan yeroo hedduu heezariin haguugame jechuudha.
eng_text: In Rogaland and Agder they are usually called "hei" meaning a treeless moorland often covered in heather.

text: Sigigaachoon cabbii waan dhabataa miti, garuu gaara irraa gadi dhangala’a. Kun ammoo, baqaquu, cabbii afaan banaa, qaqqabsisuu danda’aa, kan riqicha cabbiitiin dhokachuu danda’u.
eng_text: The glaciers are not stable, but flow down the mountain. This will cause cracks, crevasses, which may be obscured by snow bridges.

text: Laftii fi korniisni kan bakka cabbii holqaa ni caccaba akkasumas babbaqiinsisaa cufamuu danda’a.
eng_text: The walls and roofs of ice caves can collapse and cracks can get closed.

text: Andaara cabbii sigigaatuutti tuullaawwan cabbii guguddaan kan caccaban jigan, fi andaara isaa irraa ni utaalu yookaan gangalatanii fagoo deemu.
eng_text: At the edge of glaciers huge blocks break loose, fall down and perhaps jump or roll farther from the edge.

text: Waqtiin tuuristoonni buufata gaaraa heedummaatan yeroo gannaa Indiyaattii dha.
eng_text: The tourist season for the hill stations generally peaks during the Indian summer.

text: Ha ta’u malee, isaan ganna keessa bareedina adda ta’e fi toshataa qabu, baka boqonnaa gaaraa irraa iddo cabbi waaltawaa ta’e argatu fi taphoota akka cabbiirra mucucaachuu fi cabbiirra konkolaachuu ni affeeru.
eng_text: However, they have a different kind of beauty and charm during winter, with many hill stations receiving healthy amounts of snow and offering activities such as skiing and snowboarding.

text: Daandii qilleensaa muraasa qofaatu ammayuu namoota firoonni isaanii jalaa du’aniif gatii gadi buusa, kun immoo baasii imala awwaalaa daqiiqaa dhumaa xiqqoo ishii hir’isa.
eng_text: Only a few airlines still offer bereavement fares, which slightly discount the cost of last-minute funeral travel.

text: Dhaabbattoonni xiyyaaraa kana kana dhiyeessan Eeyir Kaanadaa, Dhaabata Xiyyaaraa Deeltaa, Luuftaanzaa kan balali’a Yuunaayitid Isteetsi yookaan Kanaadaa ka’aniif fi WestJet fa’i of keessatti hammata.
eng_text: Airlines that offer these include Air Canada, Delta Air Lines, Lufthansa for flights originating from the U.S. or Canada, and WestJet.

text: Haala hundumaa keessatti, kallatiidhan bilbilaan bakka qabaachu qabda buufata qilleensaa irraa.
eng_text: In all cases, you must book by phone directly with the airline.
